Shete main uferuta yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella peruta chayyav. en lecha beyadi ella shete perutot patur mippene shekkafar befachot mishshete main. mane li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella chatzi peruta patur shekkol hammode befachot mipperuta keillu lo hoda bichlum:

Mea temarim yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella tishim. roim im hayu shavin sham haeser shekkafar bahen shete main nishba veim lav patur. chamishsha o shishsha egozim yesh li beyadcha en lecha [beyadi] ella egoz echad roin im shave haechad peruta nishba veim lav patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Bamme devarim amurim bechesef o bemine sechorot uferot vechayyotze bahen. aval hakkelim en meshaarin et demehen vaafillu hen eser mechatin bifruta uteano shete mechatin hoda beachat vechafar beachat chayyav. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "kesef o chelim" kol hakkelim kechesef. teano kesef vechelim vehoda bakkelim vechafar bakkesef im yesh bakkefira shete main chayyav veim lav patur. hoda bakkesef vechafar bakkelim im hoda bifruta chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Heid alav ed echad afillu lo kafar ella peruta hare ze nishba shekkol mi sheshshenayim mechayyevim oto mamon echad mechayyevo shevua. ketzad. peruta o sheve peruta yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi kelum veed echad meid sheyyesh lo hare ze nishba. vechen bishvuat hashshomrim afillu hifkid etzlo peruta o sheve peruta vetaan sheavda nishba. vechol pachot mipperuta eno mamon veen bet din nizkakin lo. vechen kol hannishbain venotlin nishbain venotlin mipperuta vamala:

Horu rabbotay shehannishbain venotlin enan tzerichin taanat shete kesef. vaani omer shetztzarich hannitba sheyyichpor bishte main veachar kach yishshava hattovea betakkanat chachamim veyittol. shehare hannishbain betaanat safek tzarich sheyyihye benehem kefirat shete main veachar kach yishshava missafek:

En mode bemiktzat chayyav shevua ad shettihye hodaya mimmin hattaana. ketzad. kor chittim yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella letech chittim chayyav. aval im amar lo en lecha beyadi ella kor shel seorim patur shehammin shetteano lo hoda lo bo vehammin shehoda lo bo lo teano. dinar zahav yesh li beyadcha pikkadon lo hifkadta etzli ella dinar kesef. maa kesef hifkadti etzlecha lo hifkadta etzli ella peruta patur shetteano min echad vehoda lo bemin acher. vechen im amar lo asara dinarim mitzriyyot hifkadti etzlecha lo hifkadta etzli ella asara tzoriyyot patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Menora gedola yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella menora ketanna hare ze patur. aval im teano menora bat eser litrin vehoda lo bimnora bat chamesh litrin hare ze mode bemiktzat mippene sheyyachol legarrah ulehaamidah al chamesh. vechen im teano ezor gadol veamar lo en lecha beyadi ella ezor katan patur. aval im teano yeria bat esrim amma vehoda lo biria bat eser ammot hare ze nishba mippene sheyyachol lechatchah ulehaamidah al eser. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kor chittim yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella kor seorim patur af middeme seorim. shehare omer lo en li beyadcha seorim venimtza ze dome lemi sheamar lachavero bevet din mane lecha beyadi veomer lo haacher en li beyadcha sheen bet din mechayyevin oto litten lo kelum. veim tafas hattovea deme hasseorim en motziin miyyado:

Hattoen et chavero shene minin vehoda beechad mehen hare hahodaya mimmin hattaana venishba. ketzad. kegon kor chittin vechor seorin yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella kor chittin chayyav. hitchil hattoen veamar kor chittin yesh li beyadcha vekodem sheyyashlim devarav veamar kor seorim yesh li beyadcha amar lo hannitan en lecha beyadi ella kor seorim. im nire laddayyanin shehannitan heerim chayyav shevua. veim lefi tummo patur:

Kor chittin yesh li beyadcha amar lo hen vechor seorim amar lo en lecha beyadi seorin. hare ze patur veen ze mode bemiktzat ad sheyyomar lo bevat achat kor chittim vechor seorin yesh li beyadcha veyomar lo hannitan en lecha beyadi ella kor seorim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Melo asara kaddin shemen yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella asara kaddin belo shemen patur. shehare teano shemen vehoda lo bacharasim. asara kaddin shemen yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella asara kaddin rekanin chayyav shevua shehare teano hakkaddin vehashshemen vehoda lo bakkaddin. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mane li etzlecha halevaa lo hayu devarim meolam velo laviti mimmecha aval chamishshim dinarin yesh lecha beyadi pikkadon o mishshum nezek vechayyotze bo horu rabbotay shezze mode bemiktzat veyishshava. shehare teano shehu chayyav lo mea vehoda lo shehu chayyav chamishshim uma li nitchayyev lo mishshum halevaa o mishshum pikkadon o mishshum nezek. velaze dati nota:

Mane ucheli yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella hakkeli vehe lecha. hare ze patur venishba hesset sheen lo etzlo ella ze. amar baal hakkeli en ze hakkeli kolel bishvuato shezze kelyo. hoda hannitan sheen ze kelyo venitchallef lo beacher hare ze chayyav shevua. kol makom shenneemar beinyan ze patur hare ze patur mishshevuat hattora vechayyav shevuat hesset kemo shebbearnu kamma peamim:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 4:
En mode bemiktzat chayyav shevua min hattora ad sheyyitanennu bedavar shebbemidda o bemishkal o beminyan veyode lo bedavar shebbemidda o shebbemishkal o shebbeminyan. ketzad. asara dinarin yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella chamishsha. kor chittim yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella letech. shete litrin shel meshi yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella rotel hare ze chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval amar lo kis male dinarin masarti lecha lo masarta li ella chamishshim. mea dinarin masarti lecha lo masarta li ella tzeror shel dinarin velo manita otan befanay veeni yodea me haya bo uma shehinnachta atta notel hare ze patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bayit male tevua masarti lecha vehalla omer lo masarta li ella asara korin. asara korin masarti lecha eni yodea kamma hem shehare lo medadtam befanay ella ma shehinnachta atta notel patur: 
Bayit ze male ad hazziz masarti lecha vehalla omer ad hachallon chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En mode bemiktzat chayyav shevua ad sheyyode bedavar sheefshar lo lichpor bo. ketzad. mi shettaan chavero veamar mea dinarin yesh li etzlecha chamishshim shebbishtar ze vachamishshim belo shetar. en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim shebbashshetar en ze mode bemiktzat shehashshetar lo toil bo kefirato vahare kol nechasav meshubadin bo vaafillu kafar bo haya chayyav leshallem. lefichach nishba hesset al hachamishshim: 
Shetar shekkatuv bo selaim velo hizkir minyan. malve omer chamesh selaim sheyyesh li beyadcha hem hakketuvim bo vehallo omer en lecha beyadi ella shalosh vehem hakketuvim bashshetar. af al pi sheen mechayyevin oto bishtar ze ella bishtayim vahare hoda besela sheefshar lichpor bah hare ze patur mippene shehu kemeshiv aveda vetakkanat chachamim hi shekkol sheyyashiv aveda lo yishshava kemo shebbearnu bimkomo. vechen haomer lachavero amar li abba sheyyesh li beyadcha mane vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim hare ze meshiv aveda ufatur af mishshevuat hesset. veen tzarich lomar im hoda meatzmo veamar mane haya leavicha beyadi venatatti lo chamishshim dinarin venishar lo chamishshim shezze patur af mishshevuat hesset. aval yoresh shettaan veamar ani yodea bevadday sheyyesh leavi beyadcha o beyad avicha mane vehu omer en lo beyadi ella chamishshim o en lecha beyad avi ella chamishshim hare ze mode miktzat veyishshava: 
Mane li beyadcha al mashkon ze en beyadi alav ella chamishshim hare ze mode veyishshava. en hammashkon shave ella chamishshim o pachot hare ze nishba umeshallem hachamishshim shehoda bahen. haya hammashkon shave mea o yeter hoil vehammalve yachol liton alav ad kede damav hare hammalve nishba venotel middeme hammashkon. haya shave shemonim nishba hammalve sheen lo pachot mishshemonim venotlan min hammashkon. venishba hallo min hattora al haesrim shekkafar bahen. kafar bakkol veamar en ze mashkon ella pikkadon veen lo etzli kelum nishba hammalve sheen pachot mishshemonim venishba hallo hesset al haesrim: 
Mane li beyadcha vehalla omer chamishshim vadday yesh lecha beyadi aval hachamishshim eni yodea im ani chayyav bahen o lav hare ze mechuyyav shevua mippene shehoda bemiktzat veeno yachol lehishshava bammiktzat shekkafar bo shehare eno yodea lefichach meshallem hammane belo shevua. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veyesh lo lehacharim al mi shettoen alay davar sheeno yodea bevadday sheani chayyav bo: 
Mane li beyadcha vahare ed echad meid alav vehannitan omer ken hu aval atta chayyav li keneged oto mane hare ze mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava umeshallem. umippene ma eno yachol lishshava shehare hu mode bema sheheid bo haed veen hannishba behaadaat ed echad nishba ad sheyyachchish et haed veyichpor beeduto veyishshava al kefirato. lefichach shetar sheyyesh bo ed echad vetaan shepperao. vechen kafran shebba alav ed echad vetaan sheppara o hechzarti lecha happikkadon hare ze mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lehishshava umeshallem. maase beechad shechataf leshon kesef mechavero bifne ed echad veamar achar ken chatafti veshelli chatafti veamru chachamim hare ze mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lehishshava umeshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mane hilveticha lo hayu devarim meolam hevi ed echad shellava mimmennu befanav. hoil veillu hayu shenayim haya muchzak kafran umeshallem kemo sheyyitbaer hare ze nishba al pi ed echad shekkol makom sheshshenayim mechayyevin oto mamon echad mechayyevo shevua. chazar veamar parati meshallem belo shevua kemo shebbearnu: 
Mane li beyadcha en lecha beyadi kelum vehaedim meidin alav sheadayin yesh lo etzlo chamishshim. pasku kol haggeonim halacha sheyyeshallem chamishshim veyishshava al hashshear. shello tehe hodayat piv gedola mehaadaat edim:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 5:
Veelu devarim sheen nishbain alehen min hattora. hakkarkaot vehaavadim vehashshetarot vehahekdeshot. af al pi shehoda bemiktzat o sheyyesh alav ed echad o sheshshamar vetaan taanat hashshomrin hare ze patur. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 6)</small> "ki yitten ish el reehu" perat lehekdesh. kesef o kelim perat lekarkaot velaavadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot. vechen yatzu shetarot sheen gufan mamon kechesef uchechelim veenan ella laraya shebbahen. veal kullan nishba shevuat hesset im hayta sham taanat vadday. chutz min hahekdeshot sheaf al pi sheeno chayyav alehem shevua min hattora tikkenu chachamim sheyyishshava alehem keen shel tora kede shello yezalzelu bahekdeshot: 
Shete sadot macharta li lo macharti lecha ella achat. shene avadim o shene shetarot yesh li beyadcha en lecha beyadi ella shetar echad o eved echad. hare ze nishba hesset. vechen im taan veamar chatzer zo o eved ze o shetar ze sheyyesh li beyadcha shelli hu veatta mecharto li vehannitan omer lo hayu devarim meolam. ben shehevi hattoen ed echad ben shello hevi. hare ze nishba hesset veniftar. vechen hachofer bisde chavero borot shichin umearot vehifsoydu vahare hu choyyv leshallem ben shetteano shechafar vehu omer lo chafarti o shetteano shechafar shete mearot vehu omer lo chafarti ella achat o shehaya sham ed echad shechafar vehu omer lo chafarti kelum. hare ze nishba hesset al hakkol: 
Teano kelim vekarkaot ben shehoda bechol hakkarkaot vechafar bechol hakkelim ben shehoda bechol hakkelim vechafar bechol hakkarkaot ben shehoda bemiktzat hakkarkaot vechafar bemiktzatan im kol hakkelim. bechol ellu nishba hesset. aval im hoda bemiktzat kelim vechafar bemiktzatan im kol hakkarkaot mittoch shehu chayyav shevua al miktzat hakkelim shekkafar bahen nishba af al hakkarkaot shetteano immahen shehakkol taana achat. vechen haddin bitano kelim vaavadim o kelim ushetarot hakkol din echad hu: 
Teano anavim haomdot libbatzer utevua yevesha haomedet lehikkatzer vehoda bemiktzatan vechafar bemiktzatan hare ze nishba alehem kishar hammittaltelin. vehu sheenan tzerichin lakkarka shekkol haomed lehibbatzer hare hu kevatzur leinyan kefira vehodaya. aval im hayu tzerichim lakkarka hare hen kekarka lechol davar veen nishbain alehen ella hesset: 
Hattoen al chavero veamar lo shene chodashim shachanta bachatzeri veatta chayyav li sechar shene chodashim vehu omer lo shachanti ella chodesh echad hare ze mode bemiktzat. veim haya sechar hachodesh shekkafar bo shave shene kesef nishba sheen hattaana beguf hakkarka ella bischarah shehu mittaltelin: 
Shetar masarti lecha vaasara dinarin hayu li bo reaya lo hayu devarim meolam yishshava hesset. hafach alav hare ze nishba hesset shehayta bo reaya laasara dinarim veavdu baavedat hashshetar veyittol. veim amar hannitba emet masarta li veavad hare ze patur af mishshevuat hesset sheafillu pasha bo veavad patur kemo shebbearnu behilchot chovel: 
Haomer lachavero shetar sheyyesh li beyadcha zechut yesh li bo veze omer eni motze shetari o eni yodea im yesh lecha bo reaya o lo kofin oto lehotzio: 
Taan sheavad hashshetar machrimin oto cherem setam. taan ze shehu yodea bevadday shehashshetar sheyyesh lo bo zechut etzlo hare ze nishba hesset sheeno etzlo vesheavad mimmennu vechaze horu rabbotay: 
En nishbain al taanat cheresh shote vekatan. echad habba betaanat atzmo o betaanat aviv. lefi shezze hammiktzat shehoda bo lakkatan eno ella kemeshiv aveda. vechen im kafar bakkol uva ed echad veheid lakkatan eno nishba. shezze ed echad veen sham tovea shetteviat katan enah tevia gemura. nimtzeta omer katan sheamar legadol mane li beyadcha. o abba haya lo beyadcha. vehalla omer en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim o en lecha beyadi kelum. veed echad meido sheyyesh lo hare ze patur mishshevuat hattora. aval im shamar lekatan vetaan sheavad hare ze nishba shevuat hashshomrin lefi sheeno nishba mechamat taana. vechen im hoda shehaya shuttaf lekatan o appotroppos alav yaamidu bet din appotroppos lakkatan veyishshava hashuttaf vechayyotze bo betaanat shemma: 
Horu rabbotay sheen nishbain al taanat katan shevua shel tora aval shevuat hesset nishbain. vaafillu haya katan sheeno charif leinyan massa umattan nishbain hesset al taanato. shello yihye ze notel mamono keshehu katan veyelech lo bechinnam. velaze dati nota vetikkun olam hu. nimtzeta lamed shehakkatan shettaan al haggadol ben shehoda bemiktzat ben shekkafar bakkol ben shehaya sham ed ben shello haya sham ed. hare ze nishba hesset veeno yachol lahafoch al hakkatan sheen mashbiin et hakkatan kelal. vaafillu cherem setam eno mekabbel lefi sheeno yodea onesh hashshevua: 
Katan shetteano haggadol. im teano bedavar sheyyesh lo hanaya lakkatan kegon esek massa umattan vehoda hakkatan nifrain minnechasav. veim en lo yamtin ad sheyyihye lo vishallem. veim kafar hakkatan mamtinin ad sheyyagdil veyishshava hesset. veim teano bedavar sheen lekatan hanaya kegon nezakin vechabbalot af al pi shemmode veaf al pi sheyyesh lo mimma yeshallem patur vaafillu leachar shehigdil. veim haya hattovea min hannishbain venotlin kegon hassachir vechayyotze bo sheyyesh hanaya lakkatan sheyyistakker lo sachir hare ze nishba venotel min hakkatan. aval chenvani shennishba al pinkaso eno nishba venotel min hakkatan. sheen lakkatan baze hanaya shehare chayyav litten lefoalav venishbain venotlin mimmennu. veze hachenvani hifsid al nafsho shennatan mamono al pi katan. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hacheresh vehashshote en nizkakin lahen lechol taana lo letaanatan al acherim velo letaanat acherim alehen. lo lishvua kalla veen tzarich lomar shevua chamura o tashlumin. aval hassuma hare hu kevari lechol davar beinyanim ellu venishba kol mine shevuot venishbain al taanato:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 6:
Baale dinin shebbau levet din taan haechad veamar mane yesh li etzel ze shehilvetiv o shehifkadti etzlo o sheggazal mimmenni o sheyyesh li etzlo besachar vechen kol kayyotze baze. veheshiv hannitan veamar eni chayyav kelum o en lecha beyadi kelum o sheker atta toen. en zo teshuva nechona ella omrim bet din lannitan hashev al taanato ufaresh hatteshuva kemo shepperesh ze taanato veemor im lavita mimmennu im lo lavita. hifkid etzlecha o lo hifkid. gezalto o lo gezalto. secharto o lo secharto. vechen shear hatteanot. umippene ma en mekabbelim mimmennu teshuva zo. shemma toe hu bedato veyavo lehishshava al sheker shehare efshar shehilvahu kemo shettaan vehechzir ze et hachov livno o leishto o shennatan lo bemattana keneged hachov vidamme bedato shenniftar min hachov. lefichach omrim lo heach tomar eni chayyav kelum shemma atta mitchayyev min haddin leshallem veen atta yodea ella hoda laddayyanin perush haddevarim vehem yodiucha im atta chayyav o en atta chayyav. vaafillu haya chacham gadol omrim lo en lecha hefsed shettashiv al taanato vetodiennu ketzad en atta chayyav lo mippene shello hayu devarim meolam o mippene shehayu vehechezarta lo shehare anu danin bemittoch sheyyachol lomar bechol makom. vechen im taan hattoen veamar ze chayyav li mane. o mane yesh li etzlo. omrim lo mee ze panim. hilveta oto. o hifkadta etzlo. o hizzik mamoncha. emor heach nitchayyev lecha. shehare efshar sheyyidme lo shehu chayyav lo vehu eno chayyav kegon shechashado sheggenavo o sheamar lo sheetten lecha mane vechayyotze baze. hare shettaan alav shehilvahu mane veheshiv ze veamar lo lo hayu devarim meolam veachar kach hevi hattoen edim shehilvahu bifnehem vechazar hannitan veamar ken haya velaviti ufarati en mekabbelin mimmennu ella huchzak kafran umeshallem. aval im heshiv eni chayyav o en lecha beyadi kelum o sheker atta toen. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vehalach hattovea vehevi edim shehilvahu bifnehem veamar (hannitba) ken haya aval hechzarti lo pikdono o perativ chovo lo huchzak kafran venishba hesset veniftar: 
Rauhu edim shemmana lo maot velo yadu ma hen. utevao bedin veamar lo ten li meotay shehilveticha. veamar mattana natatta li o peraon hayu. hare ze neeman venishba hesset veniftar. amar lo hayu devarim meolam veachar kach bau edim shemmana lo bifnehem huchzak kafran. uleolam en adam muchzak kafran ad sheyyichpor bevet din veyavou shene edim veyachchishuhu bema shekkafar: 
Mane hilveticha kafar bevet din veamar lo hayu devarim meolam. uvau shene edim shellava mimmennu mane uferao. vehammalve omer lo nifrati. hare ze chayyav leshallem. shekkol haomer lo laviti uvau edim shellava keomer lo parati dami. venimtza hallo omer lo parati vehaedim meidim oto shepperao hodaat baal din kemea edim dame veen hammalve chayyav shevua shehare huchzak ze kafran. vechen im hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo veamar lo hayu devarim meolam veze eno ketav yadi. im huchzak ketav yado bevet din o shebbau edim shehu ketav yado hare ze huchzak kafran umeshallem: 
Mane hilveticha vehu li beyadcha amar lo hannitan vahalo peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni. uvau edim veamru lo hayu devarim meolam. lo huchzak kafran sheen haedim zochrin ella davar shehem edim bo lefichach lo huchzak kafran veyishshava hallo hesset veyippater. kayyotze bo ten li mane shehilveticha veatta amadta betzad ammud ze veamar hannitan lo amadti betzad ammud ze meolam uvau edim sheamad lo huchzak kafran. sheen adam mesim dato lidvarim sheen bahen mammash. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Ten li mane shehilveticha vahare haedim veamar hannitan peraticha bifne peloni ufeloni omrin lallo haviem vehippater. lo bau o shemmetu o shehalchu limdina acheret. yishshava hesset shepperao sheen anu matzrichim oto lahavian ella levarer devarav ulehippater af mishshevua. shehammalve et chavero beedim eno tzarich lefaro beedim kemo shebbearnu: 
Amar lo bifne edim mane li beyadcha amar lo hen. lemachar tevao bedin vehevi edim veamar meshatte hayiti becha veen lecha beyadi kelum. patur venishba hesset sheen beyado kelum. vaafillu amar lo hayu devarim meolam shehare lo amar lahem attem eday vedavar sheeno edut en adam zochro. ulefichach im amar lo hayu devarim meolam lo huchzak kafran: 
Velo od ella afillu hitmin lo edim achore haggader veamar lo mane li beyadcha amar lo hen retzoncha sheyyaidu becha peloni ufeloni amar lo lo shemma tichpeni bedin lemachar veen li ma etten lecha ulemachar tevao bedin beellu haedim. ben shettaan veamar meshatte hayiti bo ben sheamar lo hayu devarim meolam hare ze nishba hesset veniftar. sheen kan edut ad sheyyomar hallo attem eday o yomar hammalve bifne hallo veyishtok hallo aval baedut hazze lo huchzak kafran. maase beechad shehayu korin oto kav reshu kelomar sheyyesh alav chovot harebe. amar mi hu sheani chayyav lo ella peloni uva oto peloni utevao veamar hu eni chayyav lo kelum. veamru chachamim yishshava hesset veyippater. vechen echad hayu omrim alav shehu baal mamon. bishat mitato amar illu haya li mamon lo hayiti poro lifloni velifloni. veachar mitato bau peloni ufeloni litboa veamru chachamim en lahem kelum. shehaadam asuy lehareot atzmo sheeno baal mamon veshello hinniach banav baale mamon vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu: 
Af al pi shehammatmin edim enah edut vechen hammode meatzmo veedim shomin oto. vechen haomer lachavero bifne edim mane li beyadcha veamar lo hen. bechol haddevarim vechayyotze bahen kesheyyavou levet din omrin lannitba lamma lo titten ma sheyyesh lo etzlecha. amar en lo etzli kelum. omrim lo vahalo atta amarta bifne ellu kach vechach o hodeta meatzmecha. im amad veshillem mutav veim lo taan en toanin lo. aval im taan veamar meshatte hayiti bo o lo hayu devarim meolam o shello lehashebia et atzmi nitkavvanti patur venishba hesset kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 7: Hammode bifne shenayim sheyyesh lifloni etzlo mane veamar lahen bederech hodaya lo derech sicha. af al pi shello amar attem eday veaf al pi sheen hattovea immo hare ze edut. tevao bedin im amar lo hayu devarim meolam en shomin lo umeshallem al pihem. veim haya ed echad nishba hoil veamar derech hodaya. taan keshebbau ellu haedim veamar shello lehasebia et atzmi hodeti neeman venishba hesset. veim keshehoda bifnehem haya hattovea immo eno yachol liton velomar kede lehareot sheeni ashir hodeti. aval im taan shennatan neeman venishba hesset:

Kol hammode bifne shenayim eno yachol lachzor velomar meshatte hayiti bo veen tzarich lomar im hoda bifne shelosha. aval mechayyevin oto litten behodayat piv. shekkol haomer bederech hodaya hare ze keomer attem eday. aval en kotvin ella im ken amar lahem kitvu vechitmu utenu lo. utzerichin lehimmalech bo kemo shebbearnu. vechen im hoda bevet din achar sheshshalchu lo kemo sheyyitbaer hare ellu kotvin. vehu sheyyihyu bet din makkirin et shenehem kede shello yaarimu shenehem lechayyev ish acher:

Bet din shel shelosha shehayu yoshvin meatzman bammakom hakkavua lahen uva hattovea vekaval lifnehem veshalchu shaliach etzel hannitba uva vehoda bifnehem hare ellu kotvin venotnin levaal dino. aval im lo hayu kevuin velo shalchu lo afillu kibbetz otan vehoshiv hashshelosha vehoda bifnehen veamar lahen hevu alay dayyanin uva achar kach hattovea veamar kitvu li hodayati en kotvin shemma yitten lo venimtza ze tovea oto bishtar. bamme devarim amurim bemittaltelin. aval im hoda bekarkaot afillu bifne shenayim af al pi shello kanu miyyado velo amar lahem kitvu utenu hare ellu kotvim venotnin sheen kan lachush shemma yitten lo venimtza tovo paam sheniyya:

Shetar hodaya sheyyatza velo haya katuv bo amar lanu kitvu vechitmu utenu lo. hare ze kasher shechazaka hi sheillu lo amar lahem kitvu vechitmu utenu lo hayu notnin. haya katuv bashshetar hoda peloni befanenu bet din. im en katuv bo shehayu shelosha o devarim sheshshomin mikkelal shehayu shelosha choshshin shemma shenayim hayu vetau vedimmu shehahodaya bishnayim hodaya bevet din ulefichach en danin bo din shetar:

Kevar bearnu shehodaya bevet din o edut bevet din kemilve hakketuva bishtar ulefichach kotvin venotnin levaal dino. bamme devarim amurim beshello kibbel et haddin ad sheshshalchu veheviuhu kemo shebbearnu. aval shenayim shebbau ledin vetava echad mehen et chavero veamar mane li beyadcha veamar lo hannitba hen yesh lecha beyadi. ben sheamru haddayyanin chayyav atta litten lo ben sheamru tze ten lo veyatza veamar parati neeman veyishshava hesset shepperao. lefichach im chazar hattovea laddayyanim veamar kitvu li hodayati en kotvin lo shemma perao. vechen mi shennitchayyev shevua bevet din veyatza veamar nishbati neeman veen mashbiin oto shennishba. hayu haedim meidin oto shello nishba huchzak kafran leotah shevua veeno neeman leolam lomar nishbati ad sheyyode lo baal dino o yavi edim shennishba bifnehem:

Shenayim shebbau ledin venitchayyev haechad lashsheni veamru lo tze veten lo veyatza vechazar veamar parati veedim meidim oto shello perao huchzak kafran leoto mamon. amru lo chayyav atta litten lo veyatza vechazar veamar parati veedim meidin oto shello perao lo huchzak kafran shezze nishmat mehen ad sheyyachkeru dino. lefichach im chazar paam acheret vetaan shepperao ze hammamon shennitchayyev bo bifnehem velo hayu sham edim shemmachchishin oto paam sheniyya hare ze nishba hesset shepperao veniftar. lefichach hayu bekie haddaat shebbisfarad kesheyyode hallo o kesheyyitchayyev shevua bevet din omer lo bifne bet din heyu alay edim shello yifraeni o shello yishshava li ella bifne edim:

Mi shehoda bevet din sheani chayyav leze hattovea mane veachar kach amar nizkarti shepparati lo chovo ze shehodeti bo vahare edim. hare ze edut moelet veosin al pihem shehare lo hichchish edav veeno keomer lo laviti meolam:

Yesh lattoen bevet din lachzor veliton taana acheret lehachechish hattaana harishona vesomchin al taanato haacharona. veaf al pi shello natan amatla lattaana harishona. veaf al pi sheyyatza mibbet din vechazar yesh lachzor veliton ulehappech kol hatteanot sheyyirtze ad sheyyavou edim. aval meachar sheyyavou edim veyachchishu taanato haacharona shessamach aleha eno yachol lehashshio letaana acheret ella im ken natan amatla lattaana shessamach aleha. veyesh bemashmaah kemo shehishshi bezot hattaana haacheret. vehu shello yatza mibbet din. aval im yatza mibbet din eno yachol lachzor veliton achar shebbau edim. shemma anashim raim limmeduhu teanot shel sheker. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 8:
Kol hammittaltelin bechezkat ze shehen tachat yado. af al pi shehevi hattovea edim shehammittaltelin hallalu yeduin lo. ketzad. beged ze o keli ze shebbeyadcha o shebbetoch betcha shelli hu. o hifkadtihu etzlecha. o hishaltihu lecha. vahare haedim shehen yodin oto mikkodem birshuti. vehannitba omer lo ki ella atta mecharto li o netatto li bemattana. hare ze hannitba nishba hesset veniftar: 
Taan shehu mashkon beyado yachol liton ad kede damav venishba binkitat chefetz venotel kemo shebbearnu: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim sheenan asuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. kegon begadim uferot uchele tashmish habbayit udevarim shel sechora vechayyotze bahen. aval devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir af al pi shehen tachat yado shel ze veaf al pi shello hishilo keli ze velo hiskiro lo beedim hare hen bechezkat baalehen. ketzad. reuven shehaya lo keli heasuy lehasheil ulehaskir veyesh lo edim shehu yadua lo vahare oto hakkeli tachat yad shimon ureuven toen shehu shaul o sachur. veshimon toen atta mecharto li atta netatto li bemattana atta mishkanto beyadi eno neeman. ella reuven notel kelyo venishba hesset al taanat shimon. vaafillu met shimon hare reuven notel kelyo. vehoru haggeonim sheyyishshava hesset. shettoanin layyoresh: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya keli ze nire veomed beyad shimon. aval im reuven taan veamar leshimon keli peloni yesh li beyadcha vesachur hu hotzio elay vahare yesh li edim shehu yadua li. veamar lo shimon atta mecharto li atta netatto li bemattana neeman venishba shimon hesset veniftar. mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo hayu devarim meolam veen beyadi kelum neeman lomar sheyyeshno etzli veatta mecharto li: 
En kol haddevarim haellu amurim ella shehaya baal hakkeli toen ani hifkadtiv etzlecha o hishaltihu etzlecha. aval im taan shekkeli ze haya shelli venignav o avad o nigzal vehevi edim shehu yadua lo veze shettachat yado omer eni yodea aval acherim mecharuhu li o netanuhu li bemattana. af al pi shehu middevarim sheasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir maamidin oto beyad ze shehu beyado veeno nishba kelal shehare en lo toen: 
Yatza labbealim harishonim chazaka mikkelehen shennignevu. yishshava ze binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi veyittol veyachzor hakkeli labbealim harishonim kemo shebbearnu behilchot geneva. taan atta mecharto li o netatto li bemattana. af al pi sheyyatza lo shem geneva im lo haya middevarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir hare ze nishba hesset veyaamod hakkeli beyado. mikkan atta lamed lechol mi sheyyesh lo mittaltelin beyado af al pi sheyyachol lomar shellekuchin hen beyadi veyishshava hesset veyippater. im amar shellecha hen aval chayyav atta li kach vechach yishshava binkitat chefetz veachar kach yittol kedin kol hannishbain venotlin: 
Mi shehayu beyado devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir af al pi shehoda veamar lo yodea ani shehem shellecha aval peloni mecharam li o netanam li bemattana en motziin otan miyyado. afillu hevi ze edim shehayu yeduin lo. sheadam asuy limkor et kelav: 
Taan ze alav veamar sheani hiskartim lecha o hishaltim lecha motziin otan miyyado. veim hayu middevarim sheenan asuyin lehasheil ulehaskir hare ze nishba hesset shello hishil lo velo hiskir lo ella mippeloni lakach veyaamid kelav beyado: 
Al tite ben devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir lidvarim sheddarkan lehasheil ulehaskir kemo shettau rabbim ugedolim. shekkol haddevarim reuyin lehasheil vedarkan lehasheil afillu chaluko shel adam umatztzao umittato reuyin lehasheil. aval devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir hem hakkelim shebbene otah medina osin otan mittechillat asiyyatan kede lehasheilan ulehaskiran velittol secharan vahare hen levalehen. kemo karka sheochel peroteha vehagguf kayyam kach ellu hakkelim ikkar asiyyatan kede lehanot bischaran. kegon hayyorot haggedolot shel nechoshet shemmevashshelin bahen bevet hammishtaot. uchegon keli nechoshet hattuach bezahav shessochrin oto lakkalla lehitkashshet bo. sheasiyyat ellu hakkelim enan limchirat atzman velo lehishtammesh bahen baal habbayit beveto ella lehasheilan laacherim kede lehanot kenegdan o lehasekiran velittol secharan. vechen im haya leadam mishshear hakkelim veyesh lo edim shehu maskiro tamid umashilo vehuchzak lo shehu lehasheil ulehaskir hare hen kechelim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir: 
Ucheli shehefsedo merubbe missecharo uvene adam makpidin alav shello yashiluhu hare hu bechezkat sheeno asuy lehasheil ulehaskir kegon sakkin shel shechita. lefichach afillu bau bene adam veheidu shehishilo o hiskiro ze en mevattelin bahen chezkatan ella hare hen kechol hakkelim. reaya lidvarenu shehare rava hotzi zug sheosin bo hassarbal vesefer haggada bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. velule shennitbarer lo beedim shehen middevarim haasuyim lehasheil lo hotzi mittachat yede yetomim. ha shear hazzugot ushear hassefarim enan bichlal din ze af al pi shehen reuyin lehasheil ulehaskir. vedavar ze ikkar gadol baddin vehu davar shel taam sherauy lismoch alav veladun bo uvarur hu lemotze daat verauy laddayyan lasum oto leneged enav velo yaloz:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 9:
Haumman en lo chazaka bakkelim shettachat yado. echad kelim haasuyim lehasheil ulehaskir veechad shear kelim. ketzad. raa kelyo beyad haumman vehevi edim shehen yodin shehakkeli ze shello vehu toen veomer letakken netattiv lecha. vehaumman omer lo ba leyadi ella bimchira o mattana. o shettaan atta netatto li atta mecharto li achar shebba leyadi letakkeno. af al pi shemmesaro lo shello beedim baal hakkeli neeman umotziin oto miyyad haumman veyishshava baal habbayit hesset al taanato. veyesh geonim sheddanu af al pi shello hevi baal habbayit edim shezze hakkeli shello hoil veraa kelyo beyad haumman vahare haumman mode lo shehaya shello umecharo lo neeman. aval im amar lo hayu devarim meolam veshelli hu hakkeli neeman haumman venishba hesset. veim hevi baal habbayit edim shehakkeli hazze yadua lo en haumman neeman. vedin ze pele hu beenay: 
Lo raa hakkeli beyad haumman ella taan veamar keli peloni netattiv lo letakken vehaumman omer chazarta umecharto o netatto li haumman nishba hesset veniftar mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo hayu devarim meolam. vaafillu mesaro letakken beedim haumman neeman mittoch sheyyachol lomar hechzarti shehammafkid etzel chavero beedim eno tzarich lehachezir lo beedim. lefichach nishba haumman hesset veniftar veen mechayyevin oto lehotzi hakkeli. veim hotzio hoil venire hare baal habbayit mevi edim shehu shello venotlo af al pi shemmesaro lo belo edim kemo shebbearnu. lefichach im taan haumman veamar shetayim katzatzta li bischari uvaal habbayit omer lo katzatzti lecha ella achat im haya hakkeli nire bifnehem hoil vehaumman en lo bo chazaka veeno yachol liton shehu lakuach beyado hare baal habbayit nishba binkitat chefetz al hakketzitza kemo shebbearnu bischirut venoten. veim en hakkeli nire bifnehem hoil vehaumman neeman lomar lakuach hu beyadi yachol liton ad kede damav venishba binkitat chefetz venotel kederech kol hannishbain venotlin kemo shebbearnu: 
Umman sheyyarad meummanuto uven haumman hare hen kishar kol adam veyesh lahen chazaka bechol hammittaltelin kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennichnas leveto shel chavero bifne baal habbayit veyatza vechelim temunin tachat kenafav vehaedim roin oto. uleachar zeman tevao baal habbayit veamar lo hachezer li kelim shehishalticha vahare haedim vehu omer lekuchin hen beyadi eno neeman. venishba baal habbayit hesset al taanato shello mecharan velo netanan veyachaziru bet din hakkelim levaal habbayit. bamme devarim amurim bevaal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor et kelav. veze shehotzi hakkelim tachat kenafav en darko lehatzenia. veotan hakkelim en derech bene adam lehatzenian. lefichach chayyav lehachezir lefi shello hitznian ella lichpor bahen. aval baal habbayit heasuy limkor et kelav af al pi sheen ze tzanua veen derech otan hakkelim lehateminan tachat hakkenafayim hare ze nishba hesset shehen lekuchin beyado. vechen im yatza bahen megullin bifne edim af al pi sheen baal habbayit asuy limkor et kelav hare ze neeman lomar lekuchin hen beyadi. shemma nitztarchu lo maot umachar. uvilvad shello yihyu middevarim haasuyim lehasheil ulehaskir. aval devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir leolam hen bechezkat baalehen kemo shebbearnu. veaf al pi shehotzian megullin veaf al pi shebbaal habbayit hazze asuy limkor et kelav hoil veyesh lo edim shezze hakkeli asuy lehasheil ulehaskir bilvad yadua hu lo motziin otan miyyad ze al kol panim ad sheyyavi reaya shemmecharo lo o netano lo bemattana kedin karkaot: 
Afillu met ze shehakkeli tachat yado motziin oto miyyad hayyoresh belo shevua shekkevan sheen leaviv liton shellekacho o shehu mashkon kach en ze yachol lehashebio. veim taan hayyoresh taanat vadday veamar befanay netano leavi o mecharo lo hare baal habbayit nishba hesset kishar kol hannishbain. uchevar bearnu sheyyesh mi shehora sheyyishshava baal habbayit hesset veachar kach yachzir kelyo miyyad hayyoresh. veen dati nota laze: 
Mi shellakach kardom veamar hareni holech ligzor diklo shel peloni shemmecharo li vecharat haddekel hare ze bechezkato. sheen adam meez panav vechoret ilan sheeno shello. veim teano habbealim shello mecharuhu nishba ze hakkoret hesset shehu shello veniftar. vechevan shennichrat hare hu kishar kol hammittaltelin. vechen hayyored lisde chavero veachal peroteha shana o shenatayim vehabbealim toanin shezze yarad shello birshut ugezalan hu veachal vahare haedim sheachal vehayyored omer birshutecha yaradti leechol peroteha. hare ze haochel neeman venishba hesset al kach chazaka hi sheen adam meez panav veochel perot sheenan shello. af al pi shehakkarka bechezkat baalehen en happerot bechezkat habbealim. sheen adam mocher perot sadehu bishtar kede shennomar leze sheachal have shetarcha. veen tzarich lomar sheim achal peroteha shanim rabbot shemmittoch sheyyachol lomar lekucha hi beyadi neeman lomar leferot yaradti veyishshava hesset: 
Shenayim shehayu ochazin bichli echad o shehayu rochvin al gabbe behema achat. o shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig. o yoshvin betzad arema shel chittim umunnachot besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem. ze omer hakkol shelli veze omer hakkol shelli. kol echad mishshenehen nishba binkitat chefetz sheen lo beze haddavar pachot mechetzyo veyachloku. ushevua zo takkanat chachamim hi kede shello yihye kol echad tofes betallito shel chavero venotel belo shevua: 
Ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli haomer kullah shelli yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mishshelosha chalakim. vehaomer chetzyah shelli yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mervia. veze notel shelosha chalakim veze notel revia. mikkan atta lamed lechol hannishbain littol ben shevua kalla ben shevua chamura sheeno nishba al ma shettoen ella al ma shennotel af al pi shettoen yoter: 
Hayu shenayim adukin betallit ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli. ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat veze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat vehashshear cholkin beshave achar shennishbain. veyesh lechol echad legalgel al chavero shekkol ma shennatal kaddin natal: 
Haya ze ochez bachutin shebbisfat hattallit veze bachutin shebbisfat haacheret cholkin kullah beshave achar shennishbain. vechol chaluka haamura kan bedamim lo sheyyafsidu atzmo shel keli o shel tallit o sheyyamitu habbehema: 
Haya ochez haechad et kullah veze mitabbek immo venitle bah hare zo bechezkat haochez et kullah: 
Bau shenehem adukin bah ushematah haechad miyyad chavero befanenu veshatak hashsheni af al pi shechazar vetzavach en motziin otah miyyado kevan sheshshatak battechilla hare ze kemode lo. chazar hashsheni utekafah merishon af al pi sheharishon (lo) tzavach mittechilla vead sof cholkin: 
Bau shenehem adukin betallit veamarnu lahem tzeu vechalleku et dameha yatzu vechazru vahare hi tachat yad echad mehen ze toen hoda venistallek mimmenna veze toen shemmechartiv lo o nitgabber alay vachatafah hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. veim lo hevi reaya yishshava ze shehi shello veyippater. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Plaintiff and Defendant 1:
Behema o chayya sheenah shemura ella mehallechet bechol makom veroa. enah bechezkat ze shettefasah meachar shehi yedua labbealim. ketzad. hevi hattovea edim shehabbehema hazzot yedua lo veze hattofes toen atta netattah li atta mechartah li eno neeman. sheen heyotah tachat yado reaya shehare hi halcha meatzmah venichnesa birshuto. lefichach im lo hevi reaya tachzor habbehema livaleha veyishshava hesset al taana zo: 
Hayta habbehema shemura o mesura leroe af al pi shehevi ze edim shehi shello hare hi bechezkat ze shehi tachat yado veim taan atta mechartah o netattah li yishshava hattofes hesset shehi shello veyippater: 
Lefichach mi shettafas behemat chavero shehayta shemura o beyad roe. vehabbealim toanin hi yatzat meatzmah uvaa etzlecha o pikkadon hi beyadcha o sheula hi lecha. vehattofes omer ken hu enah shelli aval atta chayyav li kach vechach o atta mishkantah beyadi al kach vechach o hizzakta oti nezek sheatta chayyav leshallem kach vechach. yachol liton ad kede dameha mittoch sheyyachol lomar lekucha hi beyadi veyishshava binkitat chefetz veyittol: 
Vechen haavadim sheyyecholin lehallech enan bechezkat ze shehen tachat yado ella kevan shehevi hattoen edim shezze yadua shehu avdo vehalla toen atta mecharto li atta netatto li bemattana eno neeman veyachzor haeved livalav veyishshava hattoen shello machar velo natan. hevi ze hannitan shettafas haeved edim sheyyesh leze haeved etzlo shalosh shanim retzufot miyyom leyom vehu mishtammesh bo kederech shehaavadim meshammeshin et rabban hoil velo micha bo bechol ellu hashshanim hare ze neeman umaamidin oto beyado achar sheyyishshava hesset shellekacho mimmennu o netano lo bemattana. aval eved katan sheeno yachol lehallech al raglav mippene katnuto hare hu kishar hammittaltelin vechol mi sheyyihye birshuto hare hu bechezkato vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Hattoen et chavero veamar beged o behema o eved ze shebbeyadcha shelli hu o shaul o gazul o hifkadtiv etzlecha o sachur lecha. vehannitan amar lo ki ella ze mamoni virushshati. vehevi hattoen edim sheheidu shehen yodin shezze hachefetz o haeved o habbehema yedua shehi hayta laze. chazar hannitan veamar ken haya shellecha aval atta netatto li o mecharto li veze sheamarti yerushshati lo sheyyerashtiv meavotay ella shehi shelli keillu yerashtiv. hare ze neeman venishba hesset. shekkevar bearnu sheyyesh lattoen lachzor liton davar hannishma: 
Sefina vechayyotze bah shehayu shenayim nechlakin aleha ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli uvau levet din veamar echad tifsuha ad sheavi edim en tofsin otah. veim tefasuha bet din vehalach velo matza edim veamar hannichuha benenu vechol hammitgabber yittol keshehaya dinah mikkodem en shomin lahen veen motziin otah bet din miyyadan ad sheyyaviu edim o ad sheyyodu ze laze o yachaloku birtzonam uvishvua kemo shebbearnu:

Kol hakkarkaot hayeduot lovalehen af al pi shehen atta tachat yad acherim hare hen bechezkat balehen. ketzad. reuven shehaya mishtammesh bechatzer kederech shehaam mishtammeshin bechatzrotehen. dar bah umaskirah laacherim uvone vesoter. veachar zeman ba shimon vetaan alav veamar lo chatzer zo shettachat yadcha shelli hi usechura hi beyadcha o sheula. veheshivo reuven shellecha hayta veatta mechartah li o netattah li bemattana. im en edim leshimon shehayta yedua lo nishba reuven hesset veyaamod bimkomo. aval im hevi shimon edim shechatzer zo shello hayta hare hi bechezkat shimon veomrin liruven have reaya shemmecharah lecha o netanah lecha. veim lo hevi reaya mesallekin oto mimmenna umachazikin otah leshimon af al pi sheen reuven mode leshimon shehi hayta shello shehare yesh edim leshimon: 
Bamme devarim amurim shemmatzrichin reuven lehavi reaya o yistallek beshello nishtammesh bah zeman merubbe. aval im hevi edim sheachal perot karka shalosh shanim retzufot venehena bechullah kederech shennehenin kol adam beotah karka. vehu sheyyihye efshar labbealim harishonim sheyyedu baze shehechzik velo michu bo. maamidin otah beyad reuven veyishshava reuven hesset shemmecharah lo shimon o netanah lo veyippater. mippene sheomrim lo leshimon im emet atta toen shello macharta velo natatta lamma haya ze mishtammesh shana achar shana bekarkaacha veen lecha alav lo shetar sechirut velo shetar mashkonah velo machita bo. taan veamar mippene shello higgia elay haddavar shehare hayiti bimdina rechoka omrim i efshar shello yaggia leyadcha haddavar beshalosh shanim vechevan shehiggia lecha haya lecha limchot bifne edim vetodia otam sheppeloni gazal oti lemachar etbaennu bedin. hoil velo machita atta hifsadta al atzmecha. lefichach im hayta milchama veshibbush derachim ben hammakom shehaya bo reuven uven hammakom shehaya bo shimon afillu achalah reuven eser shanim motziin otah tachat yado vechozeret leshimon mippene sheyyachol lomar lo yadati shezze mishtammesh bekarkai: 
Hevi reuven edim shehaya shimon ba bechol shana veomed bemakom ze sheloshim yom o pachot. omrim leshimon mippene ma lo machita keshebbata ibbadta zechutecha. taan shimon veamar tarud hayiti bashshuk velo yadati shezze betoch chatzeri hare zo taana. shekkol sheloshim yom yihye adam tarud bashshuk. veim amad yoter mishsheloshim yom velo micha ibbed et zechuto. veyerae li shehaddin ze eno ella bakkefarim shehaam terudin bashshevakim shellahen: 
Umippene ma en omrin liruven im emet haddavar shemmachar lecha o natan lecha bemattana lamma lo nizharta bashshetar shellecha. mippene sheen adam nizhar bishtaro veholech kol yamav vachazaka sheen adam nizhar bishtar ella ad shalosh shanim. vechevan sheroe sheen adam memache bo shuv eno nizhar: 
Hare shemmicha shimon bimdina rechoka mippene ma lo yiton reuven veyomar lo shamati shemmicha bi kede sheezzaher bashshetar. mippene sheomer lo chavercha yesh lo chaver vachavero yesh lo chaver vachazaka shehiggia elecha haddavar vechevan sheyyadata shemmicha becha betoch shalosh shanim beemet haya lecha shetar velo nizharta bo atta hifsadta al atzmecha: 
Lefichach im micha shimon bifne edim veamar lahem al totziu davar ze mippichem en ze mechaa. aval im amru haedim meatzman en davar ze yotze mippinu hare gam zo mechaa. shehaddavar sheen adam metzuvve alav omro shello bechavvana. vechen im tzivva leedim veamar lahem al todiuhu o sheamru hen meatzman en anu modiin oto gam zo mechaa hi. af al pi sheenan modiin oto modiin hem laacherim vedavar ze yaggia elav: 
Ketzad hammechaa. omer bifne shenayim peloni shehu mishtammesh bachatzeri o besadi gazlan hu uleatid ani tovea oto bedin. vechen im amar lahem sechura hi beyado o mashkona veim yiton alay shemmacharti o natatti ani tovea oto bedin. vechen kol kayyotze baze hare zo mechaa. af al pi shello micha bimdina zo shehechzik bah ze. aval im amar lahen peloni shemmishtammesh bachatzeri gazlan hu en zo mechaa. shehare reuven omer kesheshshamati amarti shemma cheref oti bilvad ulefichach lo nizharti bishtari: 
Mechaa bifne shenayim mechaa vechotvin af al pi shello amar lahem ketovu. vechevan shemmicha beshana rishona eno tzarich lachzor velimchot bechol shana veshana. aval tzarich shello yihye ben mechaa limchaa shalosh shanim gemurot. lefichach tzarich limchot besof kol shalosh shanim. veim micha veamad shalosh shanim gemurot veachar kach micha enah mechaa: 
Hevi reuven edim shezze shimon baal hassade kibbetz perot sade zo unetanam li taamod hassade beyad reuven vaafillu taan sheshshimon mecharah lo o natan lo hayyom sheillu lo machar o natan lo haya meshammesh et reuven besade zo venoten lo peroteha: 
Taan shimon veamar emet haya haddavar uleferot horadtiv veshello hayu happerot aval hagguf lo macharti neeman vechozer leshimon ella im ken achalah reuven befanav shalosh shanim velo micha bo kemo shebbearnu:

Shalosh shanim sheamarnu miyyom leyom afillu hayu chaserim yom echad lo hechezik umesallekin oto mimmenna. bamme devarim amurim bekarkaot shehen osin perot tamid kegon habbattim vehachatzerot vehabborot vehashshichin vehammearot vehachanuyyot vehappundakot vehammerchatzaot vehashovachot uvatte habbaddin usede bet hashshelachin shemmashkin ota tamid vezorin bah venotin vehaggannot vehappardesin. vechen avadim hamehallechin kemo shebbearnu. aval sede habbaal shehi shota mimme geshamim bilvad usede ilan enah miyyom leyom ella kevan sheachlu shalosh tevuot mimmin echad hare ellu keshalosh shanim. ketzad. hayta sede temarim vegadar shalosh gederot o sede anavim uvatzar shalosh betzirot o sede zetim umasak shalosh mesikot hare ellu keshalosh shanim vehechezik. vaafillu hayu hailanot retzufin velo haya benehen harechaka karauy shehare sofan livash hoil veochlan shalosh tevuot hechezik: 
Hevi edim shehaya dar bechatzer zo shalosh shanim o shessecharah shalosh shanim hare zo chazaka. taan baal hechatzer veamar shemma lo shachan bah bayyom uvallayla o shemma ellu shehiskiru lahem lo shachnu bah bayyom uvallayla hare zo taana. omrim lammachazik o tavi edim sheshshanim ellu gemurot bayyom uvallayla o histallek. afillu bau edim veamru lanu hiskir veanu darnu bah bayyom uvallayla vetaan baal hassade veamar yaviu edim sheddaru bah bayyom uvallayla. tzerichin ellu hassochrin lehavi reaya sheddaru bah tamid. shezze haddavar taluy bahen veen taluy betaanat hammachazik kede sheyyaidu lo: 
Haya ze hammachazik o haedim sheddaru bah min harochlin hamechazzerin baayarot vechayyotze bahen. toanin oto lechattechilla uchesheyyavi ede chazaka omer lo have edim shehayita machazik bah bayyom uvallayla. bamme devarim amurim bachatzerot uvattim vechayyotze bahen shehen asuyot ladur betochan bayyom uvallayla. aval hachanuyyot shel taggarim vechayyotze bahen sheen darin bahen ella bayyom kevan sheddar bah shalosh shanim bayyom hare ze chazaka: 
Shalosh shanim sheamarnu tzarich sheyyihyu retzufot zo achar zo. hare shehechzik besade uzeraah shana vehovirah shana uzeraah shana vehovirah shana. afillu asa chen kamma shanim lo hechezik. haya darkan shel bene oto hammakom lehovir af al pi shemmiktzatan zorin shana achar shana umiktzatan zorin shana umovirin shana hare ze hechezik shehare hu omer lo hovarti otah ella kede shettaase harebe bishnat hazzeria: 
Shene shuttafin shehechziku besade shesh shanim haechad achalah rishona ushelishit vachamishit. vehashsheni achalah sheniyya ureviit veshishshit lo alta chazaka leechad mehem. shehare baal hakkarka omer kevan shello raiti velo shamati shehechzik bah adam echad shana achar shana mippene ze lo machiti. lefichach im katvu ellu hashshuttafin shetar benehen sheyyishtammeshu bah shana achar shana kevan sheavar shalosh shanim alta lahen chazaka. shehashshetar yesh lo kol vehoil velo micha ibbed zechuto. vehu haddin leeved shehechziku bo shenayim venishtammeshu bo shana achar shana im katvu shetar benehen hare hecheziku: 
Achalah shana ze hammachazik umecharah vaachalah hallokeach shana umachar lelokeach sheni vaachalah shana. im machru ze laze bishtar shelashtan mitztarfin vahare zo chazaka mippene shello micha. veim machru shello bishtar enah chazaka shehabbealim harishonim omrim kevan shello amad bah ish echad shalosh shanim lo hutzrachti limchot: 
Achalah haav shana vehabben shetayim haav shetayim vehabben shana haav shana vehabben shana vehallokeach min habben shana hare zo chazaka vehu shellakach bishtar: 
Achalah bifne haav shehaya baal hassade shana uvifne beno shetayim. o bifne haav shetayim uvifne habben shana. o bifne haav shana uvifne beno shana uvifne lokeach min habben shana. hare zo chazaka. vehu shemmachar habben zo hassade bichlal sedotav shehare lo hikkir hammachazik shennimkera ulefichach lo nizhar bishtaro. aval im machar habben sade zo bifne atzmah en lecha mechaa gedola mizzo: 
Narah shana achar shana afillu kamma shanim hoil velo nehena bah enah chazaka. vechen im patach bah shevile hammayim ufatach vesidded bilvad hoil velo achal perot enah chazaka: 
Zeraah velo hirviach kelum ella zara kor veasaf kor lo hechezik shehare lo nehena: 
Achalah shachat lo hechezik. veim haya hammakom darkan lizroa leshachat mippene sheddamav yekarin hare zo chazaka: 
Achalah arla sheviit vechilayim af al pi shennehena baavera hare zo chazaka: 
Haya hammakom shehechzik bo sela o challamish sheeno rauy lizria tzarich lehanot bo bedavar harauy lah kegon sheyyishtach bo happerot o yaamid bo behema vechayyotze baze. veim lo nehena bo bechol otan hashshalosh shanim baddavar harauy lo lo hechezik: 
Haya maamid behema bemakom mesuyyam mechatzar chavero o shehaya megaddel sham tarnegolin o maamid sham tannur vechirayim verechayim. o shennatan sham zivlo. ben sheheemid sham mechitztza ben shello heemid. im nishtammesh bidvarim ellu vechayyotze bahen shalosh shanim bayyom uvallayla vetaan al baal hechatzer veamar atta natatta li makom ze o mecharto li hare zo chazaka: 
Sade shehi mukkefet gader uva ze shehechzik bah vezara chutz laggader venehena bechol makom sheeno shamur. af al pi sheachalo shana achar shana lo alta lo chazaka. shehabbealim toanin veomrin kevan sherainu shezzorea bemakom mufkar amarnu kol ma shezzara chayyat hassade tochlennu ulefichach lo machiti. vehu haddin lechol hazzorea makom sheeno shamur ella regel chayya veyad kol adam metzuyin bo: 
Achalah kullah chutz mibbet rova hechezik bechullah chutz meoto bet rova shello nehena bo. afillu haya challamish betoch hassade hoil velo nishtammesh bo karauy lo en laze bo chazaka: 
Hechezik echad bailanot veachal perotehen veechad hechezik bakkarka uzeraah veachal peroteha vechol echad mishshenehem toen shehakkol shelli vaani lekachtiv. ze shehechzik bailanot vaachalan shalosh shanim yesh lo hailanot vekarka shetztzerichin lo vehu kimlo haore vesallo chutza lechol ilan veilan. veze shehechzik bakkarka yesh lo shear hakkarka: 
Vechen haochel kol perot ilan shalosh shanim vetaan al baal hailan atta macharta li ilan ze vekarkao hare ze yesh lo karka koovi hailan ad hattehom: 
Sede ilan shehayu bo sheloshim ilanot betoch bet shalosh sein veachal asara beshana rishona vaasara beshana sheniyya vaasara beshana shelishit huchzak bakkol. vehu shehayu asara sheachal mefuzzarot bechol bet hashshalosh sein velo hotziu shear hailanot perot. aval im hotziu shear hailanot perot velo achalan lo huchzak ella bema sheachal: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheachal hu miktzat happerot uvazzu haam shear happerot. aval im meniach perotehen alehen hoil veachal ilan mikkan veilan mikkan mikkol hassade hechezik bechol hassade af al pi shello asaf kol peroteha:

Veellu sheen maamidin hakkarka beyadan af al pi sheachalum shalosh shanim. haummanin vehaarisin vehaappotroppin vehashshuttafin vehaish benichse ishto vehaishsha benichse balah uven benichse aviv vehaav benichse habben. shekkol echad meellu en makpidin ze al ze. lefichach en achilatan reaya af al pi shello michu bahen habbealim ella tachzor hakkarka labbealim sheheviu reaya shezzot hakkarka yedua lahen veyishshava hesset shello mecharo veshello netano kemo shebbearnu:

Vechen rashe galuyyot shel oto zeman vehaggazlan vehaakkum en achilatan reaya mippene shehen baale zeroa. vechen cheresh shote vekatan en achilatan reaya mippene sheen lahem taana kede shettaamod hakkarka beyadan ella tachzor labbealim. vechen hammachazik benichsehen en achilatan reaya:

Ketzad en maamidin et hakkarka beyadan. reuven sheachal sede shimon shene chazaka vehu taan shehi lekucha beyado vehevi shimon edim shehi yedua lo vechen hevi edim sheruven yadua shehu shuttafo o ariso o appotropposo umippene ze lo micha tachzor hassade leshimon veyishshava hesset shello machar velo natan. vehu haddin lisharan. aval im lo hevi shimon reaya sheruven haya shuttaf o aris ella reuven hoda meatzmo veamar hen hu shuttafi umachar li. hoil veachal shene chazaka veyachol lomar lo haya shuttafi meolam hare ze neeman kishar kol adam:
Haummanin ketzad. kegon shehayu bonin bah o metakkenin otah shanim rabbot. yardu meummanutan im achlu otan shalosh shanim meachar sheyyardu meummanutan yesh lahen chazaka:

Haarisin ketzad. kegon shehaya aris leaviv shel baal hassade o leanshe mishpachto shekkevan shehu aris shel batte avot en memachin habbealim beyado. aval im ze hu shennaasa aris techilla hoil vaachalah kullah shene chazaka maamidin otah beyado. veomrin labbealim heach achal shana achar shana velo machita bo:

Aris shel batte avot shehorid arisin tachat yado yesh lo chazaka sheen moridin arisim acherim lenichse adam vehu shotek. aval im chalak laarisin acherim shehayu bah en lo chazaka shemma memunne al haarisin asu oto. vearis sheyyarad mearisuto vaachalah shalosh shanim meachar sheyyarad hechezik:

Haappotropposin ketzad. ben shehaya appotroppos al sade zo ben al shear nechasim ben shemminnu otam bet din ben shemminna otam avi yetomim vegadlu hayetomim vehinnichu otan. ben shemminna adam appotroppos al hotzaato vehachenasato. hoil vehen mishtammeshin birshut en lahen chazaka. avru haappotroppin mimminnuyan veachlu shalosh shanim achar sheavru hare zo chazaka:

Hashshuttafin ketzad. im haya shuttaf besade zo veen bah din chaluka af al pi sheachal et kullah haechad mehen kamma shanim hare hi bechezkat shenehem. veim yesh bah din chaluka vaachalah haechad kullah shene chazaka yesh lo chazaka shehare omer leshuttafo im beemet shello macharta velo natatta heach achalti et kullah veatta shotek velo machita kol shalosh shanim. vechen haish sheachal benichse ishto shene chazaka af al pi shehitna immah sheen lo perot binchaseha. vaafillu hitna immah keshehi arusa shello yirashenna veachar kach achal uvana veharas veasa kol ma sheasa. vechen haishsha sheachla perot benichse balah venishtammesha bahen kecheftzah kamma shanim. af al pi sheyyiched lah sade bimzonoteha veachla sadot acherot en achilatan reaya. vechen habben shehu somech al shulchano shel aviv venechshav bichlal bene beto im achal nichse aviv shene chazaka. vechen haav sheachal nichse ben ze shehu somech alav shene chazaka. en achilatan reaya:
Uven shepperash meaviv veishsha shennitgarsha afillu sefek gerushin hare hen kishar kol adam:

Rashe galuyyot shehayu bime chachamim lefi shehaya bahen koach lirdot et haam en achilatan reaya. vechen acher shehechzik benichsehen afillu achal kamma shanim en achilatan reaya lefi sheenan memachin mippene sheyyadan tekefa kol zeman sheyyirtzu mesallekin ze mimmenna. aval nishbain hesset shello machru veshello natnu. veim hen hecheziku benichse acher veamar shello machar nishba hesset shello machar lahen velo natan lahem:
Haggazlan ketzad. mi shehuchzak gazlan al sade zo o mi shehuchzeku avotav shehen horgin nefashot al iske mamon af al pi sheachal sade zo kamma shanim lo hechezik vetachzor sade labbealim:

Kol ellu sheen achilatan reaya im heviu edim shemmachru lahem habbealim sade zo o netanuha lahen bemattana reayatan reaya. chutz min haggazlan vehabbaal benichse ishto. bee ze nechasim amru benichse tzon barzel o besade sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah uvesade shekkatav lah bichtubbatah uvesade shennatan lah beshum mishshello. aval benichse melog yesh lo reaya kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:

Ketzad haggazlan en lo reaya. kevan shehuchzak gazlan al sade zo af al pi shehevi reaya shehoda habbaal bifne edim shemmachar lo sade zo velakach damim vehabbealim omrim lo macharnu lecha ella mippene hayyira hodinu lo motziin et hassade miyyado veen lo kelum. veim heidu haedim shebbifnehem mana lo kach vechach motziin et hassade miyyad haggazlan umachzirin lo habbealim et haddamim kemo shebbearnu behilchot gezela:

Ben haumman uven haaris vechen haappotroppos sheachlu sade zo shene chazaka. im taanu shehabbealim machru lahen o natnu lahen yesh lahen chazaka. veim taanu shehi yerushsha lahen meavihem sheachaluha shene chazaka en lahen chazaka. veim heviu edim shehodu habbealim laavihen shemmecharuha lahen o netanuha maamidin et hassade beyadan:
Ben haggazlan af al pi shehevi reaya shehodu habbealim leaviv shemmachar enah reaya kemo shebbearnu. aval ben ben haggazlan afillu ba betaanat aviv yesh lo chazaka ba betaanat avi aviv en lo chazaka:

Haakkum afillu achalah kamma shanim en achilato reaya. veim lo hevi shetar tachzor hassade labbealim belo shum shevua shello tikkenu shevuat hesset ella leyisrael veyisrael habba mechamat haakkum hare hu keakkum sheen achilato reaya:

Taan ze hayyisrael habba mechamat haakkum veamar befanay lekachah haakkum shemmachar li mizze hayyisrael hamearer alay hare ze neeman veyishshava hesset al kach mittoch sheyyachol lomar ani lekachtiha mimmecha vahare achaltiha shene chazaka yachol lomar mippeloni lekachtiha shebbefanay lekachah mimmecha:

En machazikin benichse katan vaafillu higdil. ketzad. achalah befanav keshehu katan shana achat ushetayim achar shehigdil vetaan atta macharta li atta natatta li en ze kelum ad sheyyochal shalosh shanim retzufot achar shehigdil:

Mi shehechzik benichse katan shanim rabbot vetaan veamar mashkona hen beyadi veyesh li chova alehen kach vechach. hoil veillu ratza amar lekuchim hen beyadi neeman shehare enah muchzeket shehaya leaviv shel ze vahare ze gove mishshivchah ma shettaan vetachzor laytomim. aval im yatza aleha kol shehi shel yetomim eno neeman shehare en machazikin benichse katan vetachzor hassade vechol happerot sheachal laytomim ad sheyyigdelu veyaase immahen din:

Achalah shene chazaka bechayye avihen mittoch sheyyachol lomar lekucha hi beyadi meavihen neeman lomar chov yesh li al avihen. vegove oto min happerot vegovehu shello bishvua mittoch sheyyachol lomar shelli hen:

Boreach shebbarach mechamat sakkanat nefashot kegon shehaya hammelech mevakkesh lahamito. en machazikin binchasav afillu achal hammachazik kamma shanim vetaan shellakach en achilato reaya. veen omrim levaal hassade lamma lo machita mippene shehu mitassek benafsho. aval habboreach mechamat mamon hare hu kechol adam veim lo micha machazikin binchasav:

Machazikin benichse eshet ish. ketzad. achalah miktzat shene chazaka bechayye habbaal veshalosh shanim achar mitat habbaal. vetaan veamar mechartah li at uvaalech maamidin otah beyado mittoch sheyyachol lomar mimmech lekachtiha achar mot baalich shehare achalah shene chazaka achar mitat habbaal velo michet bo. aval im achalah bechayye balah kamma shanim velo achalah shene chazaka achar mitat balah en lo chazaka:

Kol chazaka sheen immah taana enah chazaka. ketzad. hare sheachal perot sade zo kamma shanim uva hamearer veamar lo meayin lecha sade zo shelli hi heshivo veamar lo eni yodea shel mi hi vechevan shello amar li adam kelum yaradti letochah. en zo chazaka shehare lo taan shellekachah velo shennetanah lo velo sheyyerashah. veaf al pi shello taan en motziin otah miyyado ad sheyyavi ze hamearer edim shehi shello. hevi edim tachzor lo hassade umotziin mizze kol happerot sheachal veen potchin laze hammachazik techilla veen omrim shemma shetar haya lecha veavad ad sheyyiton meatzmo veim lo taan yachzir kol happerot sheachal. vechen haochel shene chazaka mechamat sheyyesh shetar beyado venimtza hashshetar batel batla hachazaka vetachzor hassade im kol happerot labbealim:

Habba mechamat yerushsha tzarich lehavi reaya sheddar aviv besade zo o nishtammesh bah afillu yom echad vechevan sheachalah hu shalosh shanim mechamat aviv maamidin otah beyado. aval im lo hevi reaya sheddar bah aviv kelal tachzor hassade vechol happerot lamarer sheyyesh lo edim shehu shello. shehare eno toen alav shemmachar o natan lo velo noda karka zo laavotav. hevi reaya shennira bah aviv enah kelum shemma ba levakker otah velo kenaah. ella tzarich lehavi reaya sheddar aviv bah afillu yom echad:

Hare sheachal sade zo shanim rabbot uva hamearer veamar lo ma lecha ulesade zo hoda veamar lo yodea ani shehayta shellecha aval peloni mecharah li vehu lekachah mimmecha. veamar lo hamearer peloni shemmachar lecha gazlan hu. hoil vehoda shehi shello veshello lekachah mimmennu tachzor hassade vechol happerot lamarer af al pi sheen leze hamearer edim shehi shello. vechen kol kayyotze baze. hevi ze hammachazik edim sheppeloni shemmachar lo dar bah afillu yom echad o sheamar lo befanay lakach mimmecha veachar kach mecharah li. maamidin otah beyado shehare yesh lo taana im chezkato veillu ratza taan veamar mimmecha lekachtiha shehare yesh lo shene chazaka:

Mi sheirer al sade zo vehevi edim shehi yedua lo vehevi ze shebbetochah shetar shellekachah mimmennu vehevi edim sheachalah shene chazaka. omrim lo battechilla kayyem shetarcha. im nitkayyem hare tov veyadun bashshetar. veim i efshar lo lekayyemo somchin al ede chazaka veyishshava hesset shellekachah:

Ede hachazaka sheheid echad mishshenehem sheachalah chittim shene chazaka vehashsheni heid sheachalah seorim edutan kayyemet sheen haed medakdek baze. heid haechad sheachalah ze shana rishona shelishit vachamishit vehashsheni meid sheachalah sheniyya ureviit veshishshit en edutan mitztarefet. shebbashshana shemmeid bah ze lo heid bah ze. vetachzor hakkarka vehapperot:

Mi sheyyarad lesade bechezkat shehu yoresh veachal peroteha venimtza yoresh achar shehu karov mimmennu verauy leyarshah ben shennimtza beedim ben shehoda lo ze sheyyarad techilla chayyav lehachezir kol happerot sheachal:

Shenayim shehayu orrin al hassade ze omer shelli veze omer shelli veen leechad mehen reaya. o shehevi kol echad mehem edim shehi shello o shel avotav o shehevi kol echad mishshenehem edim sheachalah shene chazaka vehashshanim sheheidu bahen ellu hen hashshanim atzman sheheidu bahen ellu. mannichin otah bidehen vechol hammitgabber yered bah veyihye haacher motzi miyyado vealav haraya. veim ba shelishi vetakaf alehen veyarad letochah mesallekin oto mimmenna:

Hevi haechad edim shehi shel avotav vesheachalah shene chazaka vahare hi tachat yado. vehevi haacher edim sheachalah shene chazaka vahare hi tachat yado. nimtzet edut hachazaka shel shenehem muchcheshet. maamidin otah beyad ze sheheidu alav ede hachazaka shehi shel avotav umoridin oto letochah. chazar hashsheni vehevi af hu edim shehi shel avotav shehare nimtzet gam edut zo muchcheshet. chozrin bet din umesallekin mimmenna af harishon umannichin otah beyad shenehem vechol hammitgabber yered bah:

Ze omer shel avotay veze omer shel avotay ze hevi edim shehi shel avotav veze hevi edim sheachalah shene chazaka tachzor laze shehevi edim shehi shel avotav veyachzir happerot sheachal. shehare lo taan kelum veen achilato reaya shekkol chazaka sheen immah taana al habbealim enah kelum. chazar ze hammachazik veamar ken shel avotecha hayta veatta mechartah li veze shettaanti techilla shehi shel avotay kelomar sheani somech aleha vahare hi shelli keshel avotay. o sheamar shel avotay shellekachuha meavotecha hare zo taana nechona shehare natan amatla lidvarav harishonim umaamidin otah beyado. veim taan battechilla veamar shel avotay velo shel avotecha en shomin lo betaana zo haacheret. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Reuven shehaya betoch sade uva shimon veirer alav veamar reuven sade zo millevi kenitiha veachalti otah shene chazaka amar lo shimon vahalo shetar ze mekuyyam beyadi sheani lekachtiha millevi mehayyom arba shanim. chazar reuven veamar vechi taale al datecha sheshshalosh shanim bilvad yesh li mishshekkenitiha shanim rabbot yesh li mishshellekachtiha vaani kedamticha. hare taanat reuven taana. sheadam kore leshanim rabbot shene chazaka. lefichach im hevi reuven edim sheachalah sheva shanim shennimtza sheachal shene chazaka kodem shellekachah shimon maamidin otah beyado. aval im achalah pachot mishsheva shanim tachzor leshimon sheen lecha mechaa gedola mizzo shehare mecharah kodem shehechzik reuven:

Ze omer shel avotay vehevi edim veze omer shel avotay veen lo edim tachzor laze shehevi edim umotziin mizze kol perot shehoda bahen sheachalan af al pi sheen alav edim sheachal. shehare hu omer shemmechamat avotav achal vahare haedim shehaya shel avotav shel ze hattoen. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hevi hamearer edim shezzo hassade shello veze shebbetochah toen mimmecha lekachtiha vahare shetari vehotzi shetar mekuyyam. taan hamearer shehu mezuyyaf vehoda baal hashshetar veamar ken hu aval haya li shetar kasher veavad velakachti ze shebbeyadi kede leayyem alav sheyyode shemmachar li beemet. hoil veillu ratza haya omer bishtaro shehare mekuyyam hu hare ze neeman veen motziin et hassade mittachat yado veyishshava hesset:

Hevi hamearer edim shezzo hassade shello veze shebbetochah toen mimmecha lekachtiha vaachaltiha shene chazaka vehevi edim sheachalah shene chazaka taan hamearer veamar heach titon shellakachta mimmenni hayyom shalosh shanim uveoto hazzeman lo hayiti bimdina zo. matzrichin ze shebbetochah lehavi reaya shezze peloni shemmearer haya immo bammedina bazzeman hazze shettoen shemmachar lo bo afillu yom echad kede sheyyihye efshar sheyyimkor veim lo hevi mesallekin oto:

Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda derech sadehu ben shehayu arba hassadot hammakkifot otah learbaa anashim ben shehayu haarba sadot kenuyot meechad hare kol echad mehen dochehu veomer shemma derech shellecha al chaveri hu. lefichach yikne lo derech bemea mane o yifrach baavir. vechen im hayu arba hassadot leish echad shekkana otan mearbaa en lo alav derech shehare omer lo atta im achzir lechol echad shetaro en atta yachol laavor al echad mehen vaani kaniti mikkol echad mehen kol zechut sheyyesh lo. aval im haya baal arba sadot hammakkifo ish echad vehu baal hammetzar shellah mittechilla vead sof hare ze omer lo mikkol makom darki alecha veyelech lo biktzara bee zo sade sheyyirtze baal hassade. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim hechezik badderech veomer zo hi darki en mesallekin oto mimmenna ella biraya berura:

Reuven shemmachar leshimon sade vehaya levi meede hashshetar uva levi learer al hassade veliton sheruven gazal otah mimmennu. en shomin lo veen mashgichin al reayot sheyyavi al otah sade vahare ibbed kol zechuto sheomer lo heach taid al hammecher vetavo utearer. vechen im heid levi bishtar shekkatuv bo hassade peloni shel reuven mitztzad mizrach o maarav hoil veasa hassade siman leacher veheid bashshetar ibbed et zechuto veeno yachol lachzor ulearer sheomrim lo heach taid bishtar ze shekkatuv bo hassade hazzot mitztzad peloni vetachzor utearer aleha: 
Taan haed veamar telem echad hu sheasiti siman velo kol hassade veoto hattelem hassamuch lammetzar bilvad hu shel reuven hare ze taana hannishmaat veyesh lo learer al kol hassade chutz meoto hattelem. veen kol haddevarim amurim ella beechad meede hashshetar shebba learer. aval haddayyan shekkiyyem hashshetar yesh lo learer mippene sheyyachol liton velomar lo yadati me haya katuv bashshetar mippene sheyyesh laddayyanin lekayyem hashshetar af al pi shello kerauhu. aval haedim en chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken kerauhu kullo vidakdek bo: 
Ba shimon venimlach belevi veamar lo hareni kone sade pelonit meruven uvaatzatcha ekne otah. amar lo levi lech ukene otah tova hi. yesh lo lelevi learer aleha velo ibbed zechuto shehare lo asa maase veyesh lo lomar retzoni haya shettetze mittachat yad reuven shehu allam kede sheetbaenna bedin veekkach sadi: 
Reuven sheirer al shimon veshimon amar eni yodea ma atta sach ella sade zo millevi lekachtiha vahare edim sheachaltiha shene chazaka. amar lo reuven vahalo edim yesh li shebbaerev bata elay veamarta li mechor li sade zo en zo reaya. veyesh lo leshimon lomar ratziti liknot mimmecha kede shello tearer velo tatricheni bedin af al pi sheeni yodea im hi shellecha o enah. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim lo taan shimon taana zo en toanin lo: 
Reuven sheirer vehevi edim shessade zo shello veshimon shebbetochah toen atta mechartah li vaachaltiha shene chazaka. ureuven amar begezel achalta. ben shello hayu edim sheachal kelal ben shehaya sham ed echad sheachalah shalosh shanim eno chayyav lehachezir happerot sheachal shehare hu omer shelli achalti veen alav edim shemmechayyevin oto beferot shehare meatzmo hoda. veze haed sheheid sheachalah shalosh shanim leyappot kocho shel ochel hu ba veillu haya immo acher hayta hassade omedet beyado. lefichach yishshava reuven hesset shello machar vetachzor lo hassade veyishshava shimon hesset sheeno chayyav lo kelum bapperot sheachal veyippater: 
Hayu shene edim meidim al shimon sheachalah pachot mishshene chazaka yachzir kol happerot sheachal vaafillu haya ed echad chayyav lehachezir al piv shehare eno machchish haed ella omer emet heid veachalti shete shanim veshelli achalti. nimtza mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lehishshava umeshallem: 
Kol hamechuyyav lehachezir happerot im lo hayu yeduin veen bet din yecholin leshaer otan keshaar habbattim vechayyotze bahen shehu yadua. ella hayu perot ilan o perot sade sheenan yeduin. hoil veen kan taana vaddait yeshallem ma sheyyode bo sheachalo. umachrimin al mi sheachal yoter velo yeshallem: 
Kol hammachazir karka mittachat yado im hiskirah laacherim keshehaya machazik bah vehayu hassochrin kayyamin motziin mehen hassachar paam sheniyya venotnin levaal hakkarka vechozrin vetovin ze shehiskir lahem makom sheeno shello: 
Asur laadam liton taanat sheker kede leavvet haddin o kede leakkevo. ketzad. haya noshe bachavero mane lo yitanennu matayim kede sheyyode bemane veyitchayyev shevua. haya noshe mane uteano matayim lo yomar echpor hakkol bevet din veode lo bemane beni leveno kede shello etchayyev lo shevua: 
Hayu shelosha noshin mane beechad vechafar bahen lo yihye echad tovea ushenayim meidim uchesheyyotziu mimmennu yachaloku. veal devarim ellu vechayyotze bahen hizhir hakkatuv veamar middevar sheker tirchak: seliku lehu hilchot toen venitan besad
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Mitzvat ase lehitpallel bechol yom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 25)</small> "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheavoda zo hi tefilla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "uleavdo bechol levavchem" amru chachamim e zo hi avoda shebballev zo tefilla. veen minyan hattefillot min hattora. veen mishne hattefilla hazzot min hattora. veen lattefilla zeman kavua min hattora:

Ulefichach nashim vaavadim chayyavin bitfilla lefi shehi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama ella chiyyuv mitzva zo kach hu sheyyehe adam mitchannen umitpallel bechol yom umaggid shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu veachar kach shoel tzerachav shehu tzarich lahem bevakkasha uvitchinna veachar kach noten shevach vehodaya laAdonai al hattova shehishpia lo kol echad lefi kocho:

Im haya ragil marbe bitchinna uvakkasha veim haya aral sefatayim medabber kefi yechalto uvechol et sheyyirtze. vechen minyan hattefillot kol echad kefi yechalto. yesh mitpallel paam achat beyom. veyesh mitpallelin peamim harebe. vehakkol yihyu mitpallelin nochach hammikdash bechol makom sheyyihye. vechen haya haddavar tamid mimmoshe rabbenu vead ezra:

Kevan sheggalu yisrael bime nevuchadnetztzar harasha nitarvu befaras veyavan ushear haummot venoldu lahem banim beartzot haggoyim veotan habbanim nitbalbelu sefatam vehayta sefat kol echad veechad meorevet milleshonot harebe vechevan shehaya medabber eno yachol ledabber kol tzarko belashon achat ella beshibbush shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 13 24)</small> "uvenehem chatzi medabber ashdodit" vegomer <small>(Nechemya 13 24)</small> "veenam makkirim ledabber yehudit vechilshon am veam". umippene ze keshehaya echad mehen mitpallel tiktzar leshono lishl chafatzav o lehaggid shevach hakkadosh baruch hu bilshon hakkodesh ad sheyyearvu immah leshonot acherot. vechevan sheraa ezra uvet dino kach amdu vetikkenu lahem shemone esre berachot al hasseder. shalosh rishonot shevach laAdonai veshalosh acharonot hodaya. veemtzaiyyot yesh bahen sheelat kol haddevarim shehen kemo avot lechol cheftze ish vaish uletzarche hatztzibbur kullan, kede sheyyihyu aruchot befi hakkol veyilmedu otan vetihye tefillat ellu haillegim tefilla shelema kitfillat baale hallashon hatztzecha. umippene inyan ze tikkenu kol habberachot vehattefillot mesuddarot befi kol yisrael kede sheyyehe inyan kol beracha aruch befi hailleg:

Vechen tikkenu sheyyehe minyan hattefillot keminyan hakkarbanot. shete tefillot bechol yom keneged shene temidin. vechol yom sheyyesh karban musaf tikkenu bo tefilla shelishit keneged karban musaf. utefilla shehi keneged tamid shel boker hi hannikret tefillat hashshachar. utefilla shekkeneged tamid shel ben haarbayim hi hannikret tefillat mincha utefilla shekkeneged hammusafin hi nikret tefillat hammusafin:

Vechen hitkinu sheyyehe adam mitpallel tefilla achat ballayla shehare evre tamid shel ben haarbayim mitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 6 2)</small> "hi haola" vegomer, kainyan shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 55 18)</small> "erev vavoker vetzohorayim asicha veeheme vayyishma koli". veen tefillat arvit chova kitfillat shacharit umincha. veaf al pi chen nahagu kol yisrael bechol mekomot moshvotehem lehitpallel arvit vekibbeluha alehem kitfillat chova:

Vechen tikkenu tefilla achar tefillat mincha samuch lishkiat hachamma beyom hattaanit bilvad kede lehosif techinna uvakkasha mippene hattaanit vezo hi hattefilla hannikret tefillat neila kelomar ninalu shaare shamayim bead hashshemesh venistera, lefi sheen mitpallelin otah ella samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Nimtzeu hattefillot bechol yom shalosh. arvit veshacharit umincha. uvashshabbatot uvemoadim uverashe chodashim arba. shalosh shel kol yom utefillat hammusafin. uveyom hakkippurim chamesh. arba ellu utefillat neila:

Tefillot ellu en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehem. im ratza adam lehitpallel kol hayyom kullo harshut beyado. vechol otan hattefillot sheyyosif kemo makriv nedavot. lefichach tzarich sheyyechaddesh davar bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberachot. veim chiddesh afillu bivracha achat dayyo kede lehodia shehi nedava velo chova. veshalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot leolam en mosifin bahen velo pochatin mehen veen meshannin bahen davar:

En hatztzibbur mitpallelin tefillat nedava lefi sheen hatztzibbur meviin karban nedava. velo yitpallel afillu yachid musaf shetayim achat chovat hayyom veachat nedava lefi sheen mitnaddevin karban musaf. veyesh min haggeonim mi shehora sheasur lehitpallel tefillat nedava beshabbatot veyamim tovim lefi sheen makrivin bahen nedava ella chovat hayyom bilvad:

Vime rabban gamliel rabbu haeppikorosin beyisrael vehayu metzerim leyisrael umesitin otan lashuv meachare hashshem. vechevan sheraa shezzo gedola mikkol tzarche bene adam amad hu uvet dino vehitkin beracha achat shettihye bah sheela millifne hashshem leabbed haeppikorosin vekava otah battefilla kede shettihye arucha befi hakkol. nimtzeu kol habberachot shebbattefilla tesha esre berachot:

Bechol tefilla shebbechol yom mitpallel adam tesha esre berachot ellu al hasseder. bamme devarim amurim keshemmatza dato mechuvvenet uleshono temaher likrot. aval im haya tarud vedachuk o shekkatzra leshono mehitpallel yitpallel shalosh rishonot uveracha achat meen kol haemtzaiyyot veshalosh acharonot veyetze yede chovato:

Vezohi habberacha shettikkenu meen kol haemtzaiyyot. havinenu Adonai elohenu ladaat et derachecha umol et levavenu leyiratcha lesoleach heye lanu lihyot geulim rachakenu mimmachov vedashnenu veshakkenenu binot artzecha unefotzim mearba tekabbetz vehattoim bedatecha yishshaftu veal harshaim tanif yadcha veyismechu tzaddikim bevinyan irecha uvetikkun hechalecha uvitzmichat keren ledavid avdecha uvaarichat ner leven yishshay meshichecha terem nikra atta taane kaddavar shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 65 24)</small> "vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma" ki atta hu one bechol et pode umatztzil mikkol tzuka baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:

Bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma. aval bimot haggeshamim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat hashshanim. vechen bemotzae shabbatot veyamim tovim eno mitpallel havinenu mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat:

Uveshabbatot uveyamim tovim mitpallel sheva berachot bechol tefilla utefilla mearba tefillot shel oto hayyom. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot uveracha emtzait meen oto hayyom. beshabbatot chotmin bivracha emtzait mekaddesh hashshabbat. uvargalim chotem bah mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. veim haya shabbat veyom tov chotmim bah mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim. berosh hashshana chotmin bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron. veim haya shabbat chotem bah melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hazzikkaron:

Bamme devarim amurim bitfillat arvit veshacharit umincha. aval tefillat hammusafin shel rosh hashshana mitpallel tesha berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot shel kol yom veshalosh emtzaiyyot. rishona min haemtzaiyyot inyanah malchuyyot. sheniyya zichronot. shelishit shofarot. vechotem bechol achat mehen meinyanah:

Beyom hakkippurim mitpallel bechol tefilla mechamesh tefillot sheva berachot. shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzaiyyot meen hayyom. vechotem bechol achat mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim. veim chal lihyot beshabbat chotem bechol tefilla mehen melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hakkippurim:

Bamme devarim amurim beyom tzom shel kol shana veshana aval beyom tzom shel shenat hayyovel mitpallel tefillat hammusafim tesha berachot kemo shehitpallel bemusaf rosh hashshana vehem otan habberachot atzman lo pachot velo yoter veen mitpallelin otan ella bizman shehayyovel noheg:

Bechol tefilla mehattefillot poteach kodem livracha rishona <small>(Tehillim 51 17)</small> "Adonai sefatay tiftach ufi yaggid tehillatecha". ucheshehu chotem besof hattefilla omer <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer veachar kach tzoed laachorav:

Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed mitpallel arvit shacharit umincha tesha esre berachot kishar hayyamim veomer baavoda elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo. bemusaf bechullo shel moed mitpallel tefillat hammusaf kemo shemmitpallel beyom tov. uverashe chodashim mitpallel sheva berachot shalosh rishonot veshalosh acharonot veemtzait meen karban rosh chodesh vechotem bah mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim:

Shabbat shechala bechullo shel moed vechen rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat mitpallel arvit veshacharit umincha sheva berachot kishar hashshabbatot veomer yaale veyavo baavoda. bemusaf matchil bivracha emtzait beinyan shabbat umashlim beinyan shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom beemtza beracha vechotem bah berashe chodashim mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael verashe chodashim. uvechullo shel moed chotem bah kemo shehu chotem beyom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat:
