Veyom tov shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat mitpallel bivracha reviit ballayla vattodienu mishpete tzidkecha vattelammedenu laasot chukke retzonecha vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu kedushshat shabbat uchevod moed vachagigat haregel ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta veet yom hashshevii mishsheshet yeme hammaase hikdashta (vehivdalta vehikdashta et ammecha yisrael bikdushshatcha) vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesashon vechulei. uvemotzae shabbat uvemotzae yom tov shel kol hashshana mavdil beatta chonen af al pi shehu mavdil al hakkos:
Bachanukka uvefurim mosifin behodaa al hannissim. shabbat shechala lihyot bachanukka mazkir al hannissim bemusaf kemo shemmazkir bishar tefillot:

Bime hattaanit afillu yachid shehitanna mosif beshomea tefilla anenu vechulei. usheliach tzibbur omrah beracha bifne atzmah ben goel lerofe vechotem bah haone beet tzara (umoshia). venimtza mitpallel esrim berachot. betisha beav mosifin bevone yerushalayim rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal hair haavela kulei:

Kol yemot haggeshamim omer bivracha sheniyya morid haggeshem uvimot hachamma morid hattal. meematay omer morid haggeshem mittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov haacharon shel chag ad tefillat shacharit shel yom tov harishon shel pesach. umittefillat hammusafin shel yom tov harishon shel pesach omer morid hattal:

Mishshiva yamim bemarcheshvan shoalin et haggeshamim bevirkat shanim kol zeman shemmazkir haggeshem. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval beshinar uvesureya uvemitzrayim uvammekomot hassemuchot leellu vehaddomin lahen shoalin et haggeshamim beyom shishshim achar tekufat tishre:

Mekomot shehen tzerichin ligshamim bimot hachamma kegon iyye hayyam harchokim shoalin et haggeshamim beet shehen tzerichin lahen beshomea tefilla. umekomot shehen osin yom tov shene yamim omer morid haggeshem bitfillat musaf shel yom rishon shel shemini atzeret umitpallel veholech kol yemot haggeshamim:

Kol hashshana kullah chotem bivracha shelishit hael hakkadosh uvevirkat ashte esre melech ohev tzedaka umishpat uvaaseret hayyamim shemmerosh hashshana ad motzae yom hakkippurim chotem bashshelishit hammelech hakkadosh uveashte esre hammelech hammishpat:

Yesh mekomot shennahagu lehosif baaseret yamim ellu bivracha rishona zachrenu lechayyim kulei uvashsheniyya mi chamocha av harachamim vechulei uvehodaa zechor rachamecha vechulei umosifin bivracha acharona besefer chayyim vechulei. vechen yesh mekomot shennahagu lehosif baaseret yamim ellu bivracha shelishit uvechen ten pachdecha uvechen vechulei aval berosh hashshana uveyom hakkippurim minhag pashut hu lehosif bashshelishit uvechen ten pachdecha vechulei:

Tefilat hashshachar mitzvatah sheyyatchil lehitpallel im hanetz hachamma uzemannah ad sof shaa reviit shehi shelishit hayyom. veim avar o taa vehitpallel achar arba ad chatzot hayyom yatza yede chovat tefilla. aval lo yatza yede chovat tefilla bizmannah. shekkeshem shettefilla mitzva min hattora kach mitzva middivrehem lehitpallel otah bizmannah kemo shettiknu lanu chachamim uneviim:

Kevar amarnu shettefillat hammincha keneged tamid shel ben haarbayim tikkenu zemannah. ulefi shehaya hattamid karev bechol yom betesha shaot umechetza tikkenu zemannah mittesha shaot umechetza vehi hannikret mincha ketanna. ulefi shebbeerev happesach shechal lihyot beerev shabbat hayu shochatin et hattamid beshesh shaot umechetza, amru shehammitpallel meachar shesh shaot umechetza yatza. umishshehiggia zeman ze higgia zeman chiyyuvah vezo hi hannikret mincha gedola:

Nahagu anashim harebe lehitpallel gedola uketanna vehaachat reshut. vehoru miktzat haggeonim sheen rauy lehitpallel reshut ella haggedola. vechen haddin noten mippene shehi keneged davar sheeno tadir bechol yom. veim hitpallel haggedola chova lo yitpallel ketanna ella reshut:

Ha lamadta shezzeman mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ad tesha shaot umechetza. uzeman mincha ketanna mittesha shaot umechetza ad sheyyishshaer min hayyom shaa urevia. veyesh lo lehitpallel otah ad shettishka hachamma:
Tefillat hammusafin zemannah achar tefillat hashshachar ad sheva shaot bayyom. vehammitpallel otah achar sheva shaot af al pi sheppasha yatza yede chovato mippene shezzemannah kol hayyom:
Tefillat haerev af al pi sheenah chova hammitpallel otah zemannah mittechillat hallayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vtfillat neila zemanna kede sheyyashlim otah samuch lishkiat hachamma:

Hammitpallel tefilla kodem zemannah lo yatza yede chovato vechozer umitpallel otah bizmannah. veim hitpallel tefillat shacharit bishat haddechak achar sheala ammud hashshachar yatza. veyesh lo lehitpallel tefillat arvit shel lele shabbat beerev shabbat kodem shettishka hachamma. vechen yitpallel arvit shel motzae shabbat beshabbat lefi shettefillat arvit reshut en medakdekin bizmannah. uvilvad sheyyikra keriat shema bizmannah achar tzet hakkochavim:

Kol mi sheavar alav zeman tefilla velo hitpallel bemezid en lo takkana veeno meshallem. beshogeg o shehaya anus o tarud meshallem otah tefilla bizman tefilla hassemucha lah. umakdim tefilla shebbizmannah veachareha mitpallel et hattashlumin:

Ketzad. taa velo hitpallel shacharit veavar chatzi hayyom yitpallel mincha shetayim. rishona tefillat mincha vehashsheniyya tashlume shacharit. taa velo hitpallel mincha ad sheshshaka hachamma yitpallel arvit shetayim. rishona arvit usheniyya tashlume mincha. taa velo hitpallel arvit ad sheala ammud hashshachar mitpallel shacharit shetayim. rishona shacharit vehashsheniyya tashlume arvit:

Taa velo hitpallel lo tefilla zo velo tefilla hassemucha lah eno meshallem ella acharona bilvad. ketzad. taa velo hitpallel lo shacharit velo mincha mitpallel arvit shetayim rishona arvit vehaacharona tashlume mincha. aval shacharit en lah tashlumin shekkevar avar zemannah. vechen bishar tefillot:
Hayu lefanav shete tefillot shel mincha veshel musafin mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musafin. veyesh mi shemmore sheen osin betzibbur ken kede shello yitu:
Chamishsha devarim meakkevin et hattefilla af al pi shehiggia zemanna. tohorat yadayim. vechissuy haerva. vetohorat mekom tefilla. udevarim hachofzim oto. vechavvanat hallev:

Tohorat yadayim ketzad. rochetz yadav bemayim ad happerek veachar kach yitpallel. haya mehallech badderech vehiggia zeman tefilla velo haya lo mayim. im haya beno uven hammayim arbaa milin shehem shemonat alafim amma holech ad mekom hammayim verochetz veachar kach yitpallel. haya beno uven hammayim yoter al ken mekanneach yadav bitzror o beafar o bekora umitpallel:

Bamme devarim amurim lefanav aval im haya mekom hammayim laachorav en mechayyevin oto lachazor laachorav ella ad mil. aval im avar min hammayim yoter eno chayyav lachazor ella mekanneach yadav umitpallel. bamme devarim amurim sheeno metaher litfilla ella yadav bilvad, bishar tefillot chutz mittefillat shacharit. aval shacharit rochetz panav yadav veraglav veachar kach yitpallel. veim haya rachok min hammayim mekanneach yadav bilvad veachar kach yitpallel:

Kol hattemein rochatzin yedehen bilvad kithorin umitpallelim. af al pi sheefshar lahem litbol velaalot mittumatan en hattevila meakkevet. uchevar bearnu sheezra tikken shello yikra baal keri bilvad bedivre tora ad sheyyitbol. uvet din sheamdu achar ken hitkinu af litfilla shello yitpallel baal keri bilvad ad sheyyitbol. velo mippene tuma vetohora nagu bah ella kede shello yihyu talmide chachamim metzuyim etzel neshotehen ketarnegolim. umippene ze tikkenu tevila levaal keri levaddo vehotziuhu mikkelal hattemein:

Lefichach hayu omrin bizman takkana zo sheafillu zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera umeshammeshet sheraata dam nidda tzerichin tevila likriat shema vechen litfilla mippene hakkeri af al pi shehem temein. vechen haddin noten sheen tevila zo mippene tohora ella mippene haggezera shello yihyu metzuyin etzel neshotehen tamid. uchevar batla gam takkana zo shel tefilla lefi shello pashta bechol yisrael velo haya koach batztzibbur laamod bah:

Minhag pashut beshinar uvisfarad sheen baal keri mitpallel ad sherochetz kol besaro bemayim mishshum <small>(Amos 4 12)</small> "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael". bamme devarim amurim bevari o bechole shebbaal. aval chole sheraa keri leanso patur min harchitza veen baze minhag. vechen zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera en bahen minhag ella mekannechin atzman verochatzin yedehen umitpallelin:

Kissuy haerva ketzad. af al pi shekkissa ervato kederech shemmechassin likriat shema lo yitpallel ad sheyyechasse et libbo. veim lo kissa libbo o shenneenas veen lo bema yechasse hoil vechissa ervato vehitpallel yatza. ulechattechilla lo yaase:

Tohorat mekom hattefilla ketzad. lo yitpallel bimkom hattinnofet velo bammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse velo baashpa velo bemakom sheeno bechezkat tohora ad sheyyivdekennu. kelalo shel davar kol makom sheen korin bo keriat shema en mitpallelin bo. ucheshem shemmarchikin mitztzoa umimme raglayim vereach ra umin hammet umeriyyat haerva likriat shema kach marchikin litfilla:

Hammitpallel umatza tzoa bimkomo hoil vechata mippene shello badak ad shello hitpallel chozer umitpallel bemakom tahor. haya omed bitfilla umatza tzoa kenegdo im yachol lehallech lefanav kede sheyyizrekenna leacharav arba ammot yehallech veim lav yesallekenna latztzedadin. veim eno yachol yafsik. gedole hachachamim lo hayu mitpallelim bevayit sheyyesh bo shechar velo bevayit sheyyesh bo mureyays beet ippusho mippene sherecho ra af al pi shehammakom tahor:

Devarim hachofzim oto ketzad. im haya tzarich linkavav lo yitpallel. vechol hatztzarich linkavav vehitpallel tefillato toeva vechozer umitpallel achar sheyyaase tzerachav. veim yachol lehaamid atzmo kede parsa tefillato tefilla. veaf al pi chen lechattechilla lo yitpallel ad sheyyivdok atzmo yafe yafe veyivdok nekavav veyasir kicho venio vechol haddavar hattordo veachar kach yitpallel:

Mi sheggihek ufihek venitattesh bitfillato im lirtzono hare ze megunne. veim badak gufo kodem sheyyitpallel uva leanso en bechach kelum. nizdammen lo rok bitfillato mavlio betallito o bevigdo. veim haya mitztaer bechach zorko beyado laachorav kede shello yitztaer battefilla venimtza tarud. yatza mimmennu ruach millematta keshehu omed bitfilla shello ledato shohe ad shettichle haruach vechozer litfillato:

Bikkesh lehotzi ruach millematta venitztaer harebe veeno yachol lehaamid atzmo mehallech leacharav arba ammot umamtin ad shettichle haruach. veomer ribbon kol haolamim yetzartanu nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lefanecha cherpatenu uchelimmatenu cherpa uchelimma bechayyenu tolea verimma bemitatenu vechozer limkomo umitpallel:
Haya omed bitfilla venatfu me raglav al birkav mamtin ad sheyyichlu hammayim vechozer lammakom sheppasak. veim shaha kede ligmor et hattefilla chozer larosh:

Vechen hammashtin mayim shohe kede hilluch 4 ammot veachar kach yitpallel. umishshehitpallel shohe achar tefillato kede hilluch arba ammot veachar kach mashtin kede sheyyifsok divre hattefilla mippiv:

Kavvanat hallev ketzad. kol tefilla sheenah bechavvana enah tefilla. veim hitpallel belo kavvana chozer umitpallel bechavvana. matza dato meshubbeshet velibbo tarud asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. lefichach habba min hadderech vehu ayef o metzer asur lo lehitpallel ad shettityashshev dato. amru chachamim yishhe shelosha yamim ad sheyyanuach vetitkarer dato veachar kach yitpallel:

Ketzad hi hakkavvana. sheyyefanne et libbo mikkol hammachashavot veyire atzmo keillu hu omed lifne hashshechina. lefichach tzarich leshev meat kodem hattefilla kede lechavven et libbo veachar kach yitpallel benachat uvetachanunim velo yaase tefillato kemi shehaya nose massooy umashlicho veholech lo. lefichach tzarich leshev meat achar hattefilla veachar kach yippater. chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat kodem tefilla veshaa achat leachar tefilla umaarichin bitfilla shaa:

Shikkor al yitpallel mippene sheen lo kavvana. veim hitpallel tefillato toeva. lefichach chozer umitpallel kesheyyitroken mishshichruto. shatuy al yitpallel veim hitpallel tefillato tefilla. e ze shikkor ze sheeno yachol ledabber lifne hammelech. shatuy yachol ledabber bifne hammelech veeno mishtabbesh. af al pi chen hoil veshata reviit yayin lo yitpallel ad sheyyasir yeno mealav

Vechen en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch kaas ella mittoch divre tora. velo mittoch din vahalacha af al pi shehem divre tora kede shello yehe libbo tarud bahalacha. ella mittoch divre tora sheen bah iyyun kegon halachot pesukot:

Tefillot happerakim kegon tefillat musaf rosh chodesh utefillat moadot tzarich lehasedir tefillato veachar kach omed umitpallel kede shello yikkashel bah. haya mehallech bimkom sakkana kegon mekom gedude chayyot velistim vehiggia zeman tefilla mitpallel beracha achat. vezo hi. tzarche ammecha yisrael merubbim vedatam ketzara. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettitten lechol echad veechad kede parnasato ulechol geviyya ugeviyya de machsorah vehattov beenecha ase baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla. umitpallel otah badderech keshehu mehallech, veim yachol laamod omed. ucheshehu maggia leyishshuv vetitkarer dato chozer umitpallel tefilla ketakkanatah tesha esre berachot:

Shemona devarim tzarich hammitpallel lehizzaher bahen velaasotan. veim haya dachuk o neenas o sheavar velo asa otan en meakkevin. veellu hen. amida. venochach hammikdash. vetikkun hagguf. vetikkun hammalbushim. vetikkun hammakom. vehashevayat hakkol. vehakkeria. vehishtachavaya:

Amida ketzad. en mitpallel ella meummad. haya yoshev bisfina o baagala im yachol laamod yaamod. veim lav yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel. chole mitpallel afillu shochev al tziddo vehu sheyyachol lechavven et dato. vechen hatztzame veharaev hare hen bichlal cholim im yesh bo yecholet lechavven et dato yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel ad sheyyochal veyishte. haya rochev al habbehema af al pi sheyyesh lo mi sheyyochaz behemto lo yered ella yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel kede shettehe dato meyushshevet alav:

Nochach hammikdash ketzad. haya omed bechutza laaretz machazir panav nochach eretz yisrael umitpallel. haya omed baaretz mechavven et panav keneged yerushalayim. haya omed birushalayim mechavven panav keneged hammikdash. haya omed bammikdash mechavven panav keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim. suma umi shello yachol lechavven et haruchot vehamehallech bisfina yechavven et libbo keneged hashshechina veyitpallel:

Tikkun hagguf ketzad. keshehu omed bitfilla tzarich lechavven et raglav zo betzad zo venoten enav lematta keillu hu mabbit laaretz. veyihye libbo panuy lemala keillu hu omed bashshamayim umanniach yadav al libbo kefutin hayemanit al hassemalit veomed keeved lifne rabbo beema beyira vafachad. velo yanniach yadav al chalatzav:

Tikkun hammalbushim ketzad. metakken malbushav techilla umetzayyen atzmo umehadder shenneemar hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh. velo yaamod bitfilla baafunedato, velo berosh megulle, velo beraglayim megullot im derech anshe hammakom shello yaamdu bifne haggedolim ella bevatte haraglayim. uvechol makom lo yeechoz tefillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo veyitpallel mippene shellibbo tarud bahen. velo yeechoz kelim umaot beyado. aval mitpallel hu velulav beyado bimot hechag mippene shehu mitzvat hayyom. haya massoy al rosho vehiggia zeman tefilla im haya pachot mearbaa kabbin mafshilo laachorav umitpallel bo. haya arbaa kabbin mannicho al gabbe karka veachar kach yitpallel. derech kol hachachamim vetalmidehem shello yitpallelu ella keshehen atufim:

Tikkun hammakom ketzad. yaamod bemakom namuch veyachazir panav lakkotel. vetzarich liftoach challonot o petachim keneged yerushalayim kede lehitpallel kenegdan shenneemar <small>(Daniel 6 11)</small> "vechavvin petichan le beillite" vegomer. vekovea makom litfillato tamid. veen mitpallel bechurba velo achore bet hakkeneset ella im ken hechezir panav levet hakkeneset. veasur leshev betzad haomed bitfilla o laavor lefanav ad sheyyarchik mimmennu arba ammot:

Lo yaamod bemakom gavoah shelosha tefachim o yoter veyitpallel. velo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe kisse. haya binyan gavoah im yesh bo arba ammot al arba ammot shehu shiur habbayit hare hu kaaliyya umuttar lehitpallel bo. vechen im haya mukkaf mechitztzot mikkol ruchotav af al pi sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot muttar lehitpallel bo mippene sheen gavho nikkar shehare chalak reshut leatzmo:

Haummanin shehayu osin melacha berosh hailan o berosh hannidbach o berosh hakkotel vehiggia zeman tefilla yordin lematta umitpallelin vechozrin limlachtan. veim hayu berosh hazzayit o berosh hatteena mitpallelin bimkoman mippene shettarchan merubbe. uma hen mitpallelin. im hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad mitpallelin shalosh tefillot shel tisha asar berachot. hayu osin bischaran mitpallelin havinenu. uven kach uven kach en yordin lifne hatteva veen nosin et kappehen:

Hashevayat hakkol ketzad. lo yagbiah kolo bitfillato velo yitpallel belibbo ella mechattech haddevarim bisfatav umashmia leaznav belachash. velo yashmia kolo ella im ken haya chole o sheeno yachol lechavven et libbo ad sheyyashmia kolo, hare ze muttar. uvilvad shello yehe betzibbur kede shello tittaref datan mikkolo:

Keria ketzad. hammitpallel korea chamesh keriot bechol tefilla utefilla. bivracha rishona battechilla uvassof. uvehodaya battechilla uvassof. uchesheggomer hattefilla korea ufosea shalosh pesiot laachorav. ucheshehu korea noten shalom missemol atzmo veachar kach mimin atzmo veachar kach magbiah rosho min hakkeria. ucheshehu korea bearba hakkeriot korea bevaruch ucheshehu zokef zokef bashshem. bamme devarim amurim behedyot. aval kohen gadol korea bitchillat kol beracha uvesof kol beracha. vehammelech kevan sheshshacha barishona eno magbiah rosho ad sheggomer kol tefillato:

Velamma noten shalom lismolo techilla. mippene shessemolo hu yamin shekkeneged panav. kelomar keshehu omed lifne hammelech noten shalom limin hammelech veachar kach lismol hammelech. vekavu sheyyippater min hattefilla kemo shenniftarin millifne hammelech:
Kol hakkeriot haellu tzarich sheyyichra bahen ad sheyyitpakkeku kol chulyot shebbashshidra veyaase atzmo kekeshet. veim shacha meat vetzier atzmo venire kechorea bechol kocho eno choshesh:

Hishtachavaya ketzad. achar shemmagbiah rosho mikkeria chamishit yeshev laaretz venofel al panav artza umitchannen bechol hattachanunim sheyyirtze. keria haamura bechol makom al birkayim. kida al appayim. hishtachavaya ze pishshut yadayim veraglayim ad shennimtza muttal al panav artza:

Keshehu ose nefilat panim achar tefilla yesh mi shehu ose kida veyesh mi shehu ose hishtachavaya. veasur laasot hishtachavaya al haavanim ella bammikdash kemo shebbearnu behilchot avodat kochavim. veen adam chashuv rashshay lippol al panav ella im ken hu yodea beatzmo shehu tzaddik kihoshua. aval matte panav meat veeno kovesh otan bakkarka. umuttar leadam lehitpallel bemakom ze velippol al panav bemakom acher:

Minhag pashut bechol yisrael sheen nefilat appayim beshabbatot uvemoadim velo berosh hashshana velo berashe chodashim uvachanukka uvefurim velo bemincha shel arve shabbatot veyamim tovim velo bearvit shebbechol yom. veyesh yechidim shennoflim al penehem bearvit. uveyom hakkippurim bilvad noflim al penehem bechol tefilla utefilla mippene shehu yom techinna uvakkasha vetaanit:

Asur lo leadam laavor achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin ella im ken haya nose massooy, o shehaya levet hakkeneset shene petachim bishne ruchot, sheharoe omer shemma yelech veyikkanes mippetach haacher. vechen im haya bair shene batte kenesiyyot yomar haroe shemma yelech levet hakkeneset haragil bo. veim yesh lo tefillin berosho muttar lo laavor veaf al pi sheen sham echad mikkol ellu shehattefillin mochichin alav shehu rodef achar mitzvot veeno mimmevattele tefilla:

Hammitpallel im hatztzibbur lo yaarich et tefillato yoter midday aval beno leven atzmo harshut beyado. veim ba lomar achar tefillato afillu keseder vidduy yom hakkippurim omer. vechen im ratza lehosif bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberacha mosif:

Ketzad. haya lo chole mevakkesh alav rachamim bevirkat cholim kefi tzachut leshono. haya tzarich lefarnasa mosif techinna uvakkasha bevirkat hashshanim. veal derech ze bechol achat mehen. veim ratza lishol kol tzerachav beshomea tefilla shoel. aval lo yishal lo beshalosh rishonot velo beshalosh acharonot:

Asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum o sheyyaase melacha meachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar ad sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. vechen lo yashkim lefetach chavero lishl bishlomo kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. velo yetze badderech kodem sheyyitpallel. aval toem veose melacha kodem sheyyitpallel musaf vekodem mincha. aval eno soed samuch lammincha:

Kevan shehiggia zeman mincha gedola lo yikkanes lammerchatz afillu lehazzia ad sheyyitpallel shemma yitallef veyibbatel min hattefilla. velo leechol afillu achilat aray shemma yimmashech baachila. velo ladun afillu bigmar din shemma yissater haddin veyimmashech veyibbatel min hattefilla. vechen lo yeshev lifne hassappar lisapper afillu tisporet hedyot ad sheyyitpallel shemma yishshaver hazzug. velo yikkanes levurseki samuch lammincha ad sheyyitpallel shemma yire hefsed bimlachto veyitassek bah veyitakkev min hattefilla. veim hitchil beachat meellu lo yafsik ella gomer veachar kach mitpallel tefillat mincha:

Meematay hatechalat tisporet mishsheyyanniach maaforet shel sapparin al birkav. umeematay hatechalat merchatz mishsheyyifshot habbeged hassamuch livsaro. umeematay hatechalat habburseki mishsheyyikshor beged ben ketefav kemo shehaummanin osin. umeematay hatechalat achila, livne eretz yisrael mishsheyyittol yadav velivne bavel mishsheyyattir chagoro. umeematay hatechalat haddin mishsheyyitattefu haddayyanim veyeshvu. veim hayu yoshvin mishsheyyatchilu baale dinin liton:

Af al pi shettefillat arvit reshut lo yavo adam mimmelachto veyomar ochal meat veishan kima veachar kach etpallel, shemma teenos oto shena venimtza yashen kol hallayla, ella mitpallel arvit veachar kach ochel veshote o yashen. umuttar lehistapper velikkanes lammerchatz samuch leshacharit mippene shello gazru ella samuch lammincha shehu davar hammatzuy sherov haam nichnasin sham bayyom. aval bashshachar davar sheeno matzuy lo gazru bo:

Mi shehaya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman hattefilla posek umitpallel. veim hayta torato ummanuto veeno ose melacha kelal vehaya osek battora bishat tefillato eno posek, shemmitzvat talmud tora gedola mimmitzvat tefilla. vechol haosek betzarche rabbim keosek bedivre tora:

En hammitpallel mafsik tefillato ella mippene sakkanat nefashot bilvad. vaafillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu. aval posek hu lemelech oved kochavim shemma yahargennu. haya omed battefilla veraa melech ovde kochavim o annas ba kenegdo yekatztzer veim eno yachol yafsik. vechen im raa nechashim veakrabbim baim kenegdo im higgiu elav vehaya darkan beotan hammekomot shehen memitin posek uvoreach. veim lo haya darkan lehamit eno posek:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim chayyavim bitfilla. vechol ish sheppatur mikkeriat shema patur min hattefilla. vechol hamelavvin et hammet af al pi sheen lammitta tzorech bahen peturin min hattefilla:

Keshettikkennu chachamim divre tefillot ellu tikkenu berachot acherot levarech otan bechol yom, ellu hen. kesheyyikkanes adam lemittato lishon ballayla mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammappil chevle shena al enay vehammashkia shenat tardema vehammeir leishon bat ayin. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettatztzileni miyyetzer ra umippega ra veal yevahaluni chalomot raim velo hirhurim raim utehe mittati shelema lefanecha vetaamideni mimmenna lechayyim uleshalom vehaira enay pen ishan hammavet. baruch atta Adonai hammeir laolam kullo bichvodo:

Vekore parasha rishona mikkeriat shema veyashen. vaafillu ishto yeshena immo (kore pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan). veim anasattu shena kore afillu pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan:

Beshaa sheyyikatz besof shenato mevarech vehu al mittato kach. elohay neshama shennatatta bi tehora atta beratah veatta yetzartah veatta nefachtah bi veatta meshammerah bekirbi veatta atid littelah mimmenni veatta atid lehachazirah bi leatid lavo. kol zeman shehanneshama teluya bekirbi mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay ribbon kol hammaasim baruch atta Adonai hammachazir neshamot lifgarim metim:

Kesheshshomea kol hattarnegolim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hannoten lassechvi vina lehavechin ben yom uven layla. keshellovesh begadav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam malbish arumim. keshemmanniach sedino al rosho mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam oter yisrael betifara. keshemmaavir yadav al enav mevarech pokeach ivrim. kesheyyeshev al mittato mevarech mattir asurim. keshemmorid raglav min hammitta umannicham al gabbe karka mevarech roka haaretz al hammayim. kesheomed mevarech zokef kefufim. keshennotel yadav mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. kesherochetz panav mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammaavir chevle shena meenay utenuma meafappay, yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay velohe avotay shettargileni lidvar mitzva veal targileni lidvar avera veavon vetashlet bi yetzer tov veal yishlot bi yetzer ra utechazzekeni bemitzvotecha veten chelki betoratecha vetitteneni lechen ulechesed ulerachamim beenecha uveene chol roay vetigmeleni chasadim tovim, baruch atta Adonai gomel chasadim tovim:

Vechol zeman sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse omer kodem sheyyikkanes hitkabbedu mechubbadim kedoshim mesharte elyon izruni izruni shimruni shimruni hametinu li ad sheekkanes veetze shezze darkan shel bene adam. veachar sheyyatza mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam bechachma uvara vo nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim galuy veyadua lifne chisse chevodecha sheim yissatem echad mehem o im yippateach echad mehem i efshar lehitkayyem afillu shaa achat baruch atta Adonai rofe chol basar umafli laasot:

Keshchoger chagoro mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. keshellovesh nealav mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. keshemmehallech latzet ladderech mevarech hammechin mitzade gaver. umevarech adam bechol yom baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani goy. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani ishsha. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello asani aved:

Shemone esre berachot ellu en lahem seder ella mevarech kol achat mehen al davar shehabberacha bishvilo bishato. ketzad. hare shechagar chagoro vehu al mittato mevarech ozer yisrael bigvura. shama kol hattarnegol mevarech hannoten lassechvi vina. vechol beracha mehen shello nitchayyev bah eno mevarech otah:

Ketzad. lan bichsuto eno mevarech kesheomed malbish arumim. halach yachef eno mevarech sheasita li kol tzarki. beyom hakkippurim uvetisha beav sheen sham rechitza eno mevarech al netilat yadayim velo hammaavir chevle shena. im lo nichnas levet hakkisse eno mevarech asher yatzar et haadam. vechen shear berachot ellu:

Nahagu haam berov arenu levarech berachot ellu zo achar zo bevet hakkeneset ben nitchayyevu bahen ben lo nitchayyevu bahen. vetaut hu veen rauy laasot ken velo yevarech beracha ella im ken nitchayyev bah:

Hammashkim likro battora kodem sheyyikra keriat shema ben kara battora shebbichtav ben kara battora shebbeal pe notel yadav techilla umevarech shalosh berachot veachar kach kore. veellu hen. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al divre tora. vehaarev na Adonai elohenu et divre toratcha befinu uvefippiyyot ammecha kol bet yisrael venihye anachnu vetzeetzaenu vetzeetzae ammecha yode shemecha veoske toratecha lishmah baruch atta Adonai hamelammed tora leammo yisrael. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol haammim venatan lanu et torato baruch atta Adonai noten hattora:

Bechol yom chayyav adam levarech shalosh berachot ellu veachar kach kore meat middivre tora. venahagu haam likro <small>(Bamidbar 6 22 27)</small> "birkat kohanim". veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Bamidbar 28 2)</small> "tzav et bene yisrael". veyesh mekomot shekkorin shetehen. vekorin perakim o halachot min hammishna umin habberaytot:

Veshibbechu chachamim lemi shekkore zemirot missefer tehillim bechol yom vayom mi<small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" ad sof hassefer. uchevar nahagu likrot pesukim lifnehem uleacharehem vetikkenu beracha lifne hazzemirot vehi baruch sheamar uveracha leacharehem vehi yishtabbach. veachar kach mevarech al keriat shema vekore keriat shema:

Yesh mekomot shennahagu bahen likrot bechol yom achar shemmevarchin yishtabbach <small>(Shemot 15 1 19)</small> "shirat hayyam" veachar kach mevarchin al shema. veyesh mekomot shekkorin <small>(Devarim 32 1 43)</small> "shirat haazinu". veyesh yechidim shekkorin shete hashshirot hakkol lefi hamminhag:

Chayyav adam levarech mea berachot ben hayyom vehallayla. uma hen mea berachot ellu. 23 berachot shemmaninu beferek ze. vesheva berachot shel keriat shema shel shacharit vearvit lefaneha uleachareha. ucheshemmitattef batztzitzit mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. ucheshellovesh tefillin mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehaniach tefillin. veshalosh tefillot shebbechol tefilla mehen shemone esre berachot hare shemonim veshesh berachot. ucheshehu ochel shete seuddot shel yom vehallayla mevarech arba esre berachot. sheva bechol seudda. achat kesheyyittol yadav techilla. veal hammazon achat battechilla veshalosh bassof veal hayyayin lefanav uleacharav hare sheva berachot hare mea berachot ben hakkol:

Bazzeman hazze shettikkenu birkat haeppikorosin battefilla vehosifu hattov vehammetiv bevirkat hammazon nimtzeu chamesh berachot yeterot. beshabbatot veyamim tovim shehattefilla sheva berachot, vechen im lo nitchayyev bishar hayyamim bechol habberachot haellu kegon shello yashan kol hallayla velo hittir chagoro velo nichnas levet hakkisse vechayyotze beellu, tzarich lehashelim mea berachot min happerot:
Ketzad. ochel meat yarak umevarech lefanav uleacharav vechozer veochel meat mipperi ze umevarech lefanav uleacharav umone kol habberachot ad shemmashlim mea bechol yom:

Seder tefillot kach hu. bashshachar mashkim adam umevarech berachot ellu. vekore hazzemirot umevarech lifnehem uleacharehem. vekore achar kach shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. umedalleg kedushsha min habberacha rishona shellefaneha sheen hayyachid omer kedushsha. ucheshehu chotem gaal yisrael miyyad yaamod kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad kemo sheamarnu. uchesheyyashlim yeshev veyippol al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho umitchannen meat vehu yoshev bedivre tachanunim. veachar kach yikra <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" (meyushshav) veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav:

Uvitfillat hammincha matchil likro <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" meyushshav veachar kach omed umitpallel tefillat hammincha ucheshemmashlim nofel al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav. uvitfillat haerev kore keriat shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha vesomech geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad uchesheyyashlim yeshev meat veyippater. vehammitchannen achar tefillat arvit hare ze meshubbach. veaf al pi shemmevarech hashekivenu achar gaal yisrael enah hefsek ben geulla litfilla vahare shetehen kivracha achat arukka:

Tefillat hatztzibbur nishmaat tamid vaafillu hayu bahen chotim en hakkadosh baruch hu moes bitfillatan shel rabbim. lefichach tzarich adam leshattef atzmo im hatztzibbur. velo yitpallel beyachid kol zeman sheyyachol lehitpallel im hatztzibbur. uleolam yashkim adam veyaariv levet hakkeneset sheen tefillato nishmaat bechol et ella bevet hakkeneset. vechol mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro veeno mitpallel bo im hatztzibbur nikra shachen ra:

Umitzva larutz levet hakkeneset shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 6 3)</small> "veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai". uchesheyyetze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa ella yelech meat meat. uchesheyyikkanes bevet hakkeneset yikkanes shiur shene petachim veachar kach yitpallel lekayyem ma shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 8 34)</small> "lishmor mezuzot petachay":

Bet hammidrash gadol mibbet hakkeneset. vachachamim gedolim af al pi shehayu lahem beiram batte kenesiyyot harebe lo hayu mitpallelin ella bemakom shehayu oskin sham battora vehu sheyyitpallel sham tefillat hatztzibbur:

Vechetzad hi tefillat hatztzibbur. yihye echad mitpallel bekol ram vehakkol shomim. veen osin ken befachot measara gedolim uvene chorin. usheliach tzibbur echad mehem. vaafillu hayu miktzatan shekkevar hitpallelu veyatzu yede chovatan mashlimin lahem laasara. vehu sheyyihyu rov haasara shello hitpallelu. vechen en omrim kedushsha velo korin battora umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha velo maftirin banneviim ella baasara:

Vechen lo yihye echad mevarech birkat shema vehakkol shomim veonin acharav amen ella baasara. veze hu hannikra pores al shema. veen omrim kaddish ella baasara. veen hakkohanim nosim yedehem ella baasara vehakkohanim min hamminyan. shekkol asara miyyisrael hem hannikraim eda shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 14 27)</small> "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot" vegomer vehayu asara shehare yatzu yehoshua vechalev:

Vechol devar kedushsha lo yehe ella betoch haeda miyyisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". vechol ellu haddevarim im hitchilu bahem baasara vehalchu miktzatam af al pi sheen rashshain yigmeru hashshear:

Vetzarich lihyot kullam bemakom echad usheliach tzibbur immahem bemakom echad. chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah lechatzer gedola vehayu tisha baggedola veyachid bakketanna mitztarfin. tisha bakketanna veyachid baggedola en mitztarfin. tzibbur baggedola usheliach tzibbur bakketanna yotzin yede chovatan. tzibbur bakketanna usheliach tzibbur baggedola en yotzin yede chovatan shehare hu muflag mehem veeno immahem bemakom echad mippene sheyyesh baggedola passin mikkan umikkan hare hi kemo mufleget min hakketanna veen hakketanna mufleget min haggedola ella hare hi kekeren zavit shellah:

Vechen im hayta tzoa baggedola asur lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema bakketanna. hayta tzoa bakketanna muttar lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema baggedola im lo haya sham reach ra mippene shehi mufleget mimmenna:

Sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan. ketzad. beshaa shehu mitpallel vehem shomin veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha hare hen kemitpallelin. bamme devarim amurim kesheeno yodea lehitpallel aval hayyodea eno yotze yede chovato ella bitfillat atzmo:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana chutz merosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shel shenat hayyovel. aval bishne yamim ellu sheliach tzibbur motzi et hayyodea keshem shemmotzi mi sheeno yodea mippene shehem berachot arukkot veen rov hayyodim otan yecholin lechavven datan kishliach tzibbur. lefichach im ratza hayyodea lismoch bishne yamim ellu al tefillat shatz lehotzio yede chovato harshut beyado:

En memannin sheliach tzibbur ella gadol shebbatztzibbur bechachmato uvemaasav. veim haya zaken hare ze meshubbach beyoter. umishtaddelin lihyot sheliach tzibbur adam shekkolo arev veragil likrot. umi shello nitmalle zekano af al pi shehu chacham gadol lo yehe shatz mippene kevod tzibbur. aval pores hu al shema mishsheyyavi shete searot achar shelosh esre shanim:

Vechen hailleg kegon mi shekkore lealef ayin o leayin alef vechol mi sheeno yachol lehotzi et haotiyyot ketikkunan en memannin oto sheliach tzibbur. veharav memanne echad mittalmidav lehitpallel lefanav betzibbur. hassuma pores al shema venaase sheliach tzibbur. aval mi shekketefav megullot af al pi shehu pores al shema eno naase sheliach tzibbur litfilla ad sheyyihye atuf:

Seder tefillot hatztzibbur kach hu. bashshachar kol haam yoshvim usheliach tzibbur yored lifne hatteva veomed beemtza haam umatchil veomer kaddish vechol haam onim amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach lealam ulealme almayya bechol kochan. veonin amen besof kaddish. veachar kach omer barchu et Adonai hamevorach vehem onim baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil ufores al shema bekol ram vehem onim amen achar kol beracha uveracha. vehayyodea levarech velikrot immo kore ad shemmevarech gaal yisrael:

Vehakkol omdin miyyad umitpallelim belachash. umi sheeno yodea lehitpallel omed veshotek ad sheyyitpallel sheliach tzibbur belachash im shear haam. vechol mi sheyyigmor tefillato im hatztzibbur yafsia shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod bammakom shehiggia elav beet sheyyafsia:

Veachar sheyyafsia sheliach tzibbur shalosh pesiot laachorav veyaamod matchil umitpallel bekol ram mittechillat habberachot lehotzi et mi shello hitpallel. vehakkol omdim veshomim veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha. ben ellu shello yatzu yede chovatan ben ellu shekkevar yatzu yede chovatan:

Veomer kedushsha bivracha shelishit. vechevan shehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yesh reshut lechol echad veechad lachazor bammakom sheamad bo battefilla. uchesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lemodim vechorea kol haam shochin meat velo yishchu yoter midday. veomrim modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu velohe chol basar yotzrenu yotzer bereshit berachot vehodaot leshimcha haggadol vehakkadosh al shehecheyitanu vekiyyamtanu ken techayyenu utechanenu veteesof galuyyotenu lechatzrot kadshecha lishmor chukkecha uleavdecha beemet velaasot retzoncha belevav shalem al sheanu modim lach. vechol haomer modim modim meshattekin oto:

Veachar sheyyashlim kol hattefilla yeshev veyippol al panav veyitte meat hu vechol hatztzibbur veyitchannen vehu nofel. veyeshev veyagbiah rosho hu ushear haam umitchannen meat bekol ram meyushshav. veachar kach yaamod sheliach tzibbur levaddo veomer kaddish paam sheniyya vehem onim kederech sheonin battechilla. veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 38)</small> "vehu rachum" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla" vechulei. hu omed vehem yoshvim vehem korim immo. veachar kach omer <small>(yeshaya 59 20)</small> "uva letziyyon goel" vechulei <small>(yeshaya 59 21)</small> "vaani zot" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 22 4)</small> "veatta kadosh" <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh" vegomer hakkedushsha vehem onin <small>(yeshaya 6 3)</small> "kadosh kadosh" shalosh peamim. vechozer vekore hakkedushsha targum veomer <small>(Yechezkel 3 12)</small> "vattissaeni ruach" vechulei vekore oto targum veomer <small>(Shemot 15 18)</small> "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed" vekorehu targum kede lehavin haam:

Veellu happesukim shellifne hakkedushsha veshel achareha im targuman hem hannikrain seder kedushsha. veachar kach mitchannen bedivre tachanunim uvifsuke rachamim veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin:

Mi sheamar betachanunim mi sherichem al kan tzippor shello likkach haem al habbanim o shello lishchot oto veet beno beyom echad yerachem alenu vechayyotze beinyan ze meshattekin oto. mippene shemmitzvot ellu gezerat hakkatuv hen veenan rachamim. sheillu hayu mippene rachamim lo haya mattir lanu shechita kol ikkar. vechen lo yarbe bechinnuyim shel shem veyomar <small>(Devarim 10 17)</small> "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora" vehechazak vehaammitz vehaizzuz. sheen koach baadam lehaggia besof shevachav. ella omer ma sheamar moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom:

Bemincha omer sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve betecha" vechulei <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei kore hu vehaam meyushshav veomed sheliach tzibbur veomer kaddish vehem omdim acharav veonin kedarkan umitpallelin kullam belachash. veachar kach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit ad sheyyashlim kol hattefilla. venoflim al penehem umitchannen umagbiah rosho hu vehem. umitchannen meat meyushshav kederech sheasa beshacharit veomed veomer kaddish vechol haam onin kedarkan veniftarin lemaasehem:

Baerev kol haam yoshvin vehu omed veomer <small>(Tehillim 78 38)</small> "vehu rachum" kulei barchu et Adonai hamevorach vechulei vehem onin baruch Adonai hamevorach leolam vaed. umatchil lifros al shema veomer kaddish veachar kach hakkol omdim umitpallelin belachash. ucheshemmashlimin omer kaddish vehem niftarin. veeno chozer lehitpallel bekol ram arvit lefi sheen tefillat arvit chova lefichach lo yevarech berachot levattala sheen kan adam shennitchayyev bahem kede lehotzio yede chovato:

Belele shabbatot chozer shatz achar shemmitpallel belachash im hatztzibbur umitpallel bekol ram. aval eno mitpallel sheva ella beracha achat meen sheva. vechen hu omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora el elyon kone berachamav shamayim vaaretz. magen avot bidvaro mechayye metim bemaamaro hael hakkadosh sheen kamohu hammeniach leammo beshabbat kadsho ki vam ratza lehaniach lahem lefanav naavod beyira vafachad venode lishmo bechol yom tamid meen habberachot el hahodaot adon hashshalom mekaddesh hashshabbat umevarech hashshevii umeniach bikdushsha leam medushshene oneg zecher lemaase vereshit. elohenu velohe avotenu retze na bimnuchatenu vechulei baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat. veomer kaddish veniftarin kol haam:

Velamma tikkenu chachamim ze. mippene sherov haam bain lehitpallel arvit belele shabbatot veyihye sham mi shennitacher lavo velo hishlim tefillato veyishshaer levaddo bevet hakkeneset veyavo lide sakkana. lefichach chozer sheliach tzibbur umitpallel kede sheyyitakkevu kol haam ad sheyyashlim hammitacher veyetze immahem:

Lefichach yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat o yom hakkippurim o rosh chodesh en sheliach tzibbur hayyored arvit lifne hatteva mazkir inyan hayyom bivracha zo aval chotem bah mekaddesh hashshabbat bilvad lefi shello nitchayyev hayyom bivracha zo:

Beshabbatot veyamim tovim kesheggomer sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit bekol ram omer kaddish veachar kach <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" vechulei veomer kaddish. umitpallelin musaf belachash veachar kach mitpallel musaf bekol ram kederech sheasa beshacharit. veomer kaddish achar tefillat musaf vehaam niftarin. veen omrin kedushsha vetachanunim achar tefillat shacharit kishar hayyamim ella omer otah kodem tefillat hammincha. ketzad. kore tehilla ledavid veomer seder hayyom vedivre tachanunim veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha vechozer umashmia tefillat mincha bekol ram veomer kaddish:
Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed omer seder kedushsha kodem tefillat musaf. bemotzae shabbat omer seder hayyom gam achar tefillat haerev veomrim kaddish veachar kach mavdil:

Mi shehitpallel velo kivven et libbo yachazor veyitpallel bechavvana. veim kivven et libbo bivracha rishona shuv eno tzarich. mi shettaa beachat mishshalosh berachot harishonot chozer larosh. veim taa beachat mishshalosh berachot acharonot yachazor laavoda. veim taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot chozer litchillat beracha shettaa bah umashlim tefillato al hasseder. vechen sheliach tzibbur shettaa keshehu mitpallel bekol ram al derech zo hu chozer:

Aval im taa sheliach tzibbur keshehu mitpallel belachash ani omer sheeno chozer umitpallel paam sheniyya mippene torach tzibbur ella somech al hattefilla shemmitpallel bekol ram. vehu shello taa beshalosh rishonot sheim taa bahem leolam chozer kemo shehayyachid chozer:

Sheliach tzibbur shettaa venivhal velo yada mehechan yatchil veshaha shaa yaamod acher tachtav. veim taa bevirkat haeppikorsin en mamtinin lo ella miyyad yaamod acher tachtav shemma eppikorsut nizreka bo. vehu shello hitchil bah aval im hitchil bah mamtinin lo shaa. velo yehe hashsheni sarvan beotah shaa:

Umehechan hu matchil, mittechillat beracha shettaa bah rishon im taa beachat min haemtzaiyyot. aval im taa beachat min hashshalosh rishonot matchil hashsheni min harosh. veim taa beachat min haacharonot yatchil hashsheni min haavoda:
Haomer eni yored lifne hatteva mippene shebbegaday tzevuim af bilvanim lo yaavor beotah tefilla. amar eni over mippene sheyyesh beragli sandal af yachef lo yaavor:

Mi shennistappek lo im hitpallel im lo hitpallel eno chozer umitpallel ella im ken mitpallel tefilla zo al daat shehi nedava. sheim ratza yachid lehitpallel kol hayyom tefillat nedava yitpallel. mi shehaya omed bitfilla venizkar shekkevar hitpallel posek vaafillu beemtza beracha. veim hayta tefillat arvit eno posek shello hitpallel otah mittechilla ella al daat sheenah chova:

Mi shettaa vehitpallel shel chol beshabbat lo yatza. veim nizkar vehu betoch hattefilla gomer beracha shehitchil bah vechozer umitpallel shel shabbat. bamme devarim amurim bearvit o beshacharit o bemincha. aval bemusaf posek afillu beemtza habberacha. vechen im hishlim tefilla shel chol al daat shehu musaf chozer umitpallel musaf. echad shabbat veechad yom tov veechad rosh chodesh:

Mi shettaa bimot haggeshamim velo amar morid haggeshem velo morid hattal chozer larosh. veim hizkir hattal eno chozer. veim taa bimot hachamma veamar morid haggeshem chozer larosh. veim lo hizkir tal en machzirin oto, sheen hattal neetzar veen tzarich bakkasha:

Mi sheshshachach sheela bevirkat hashshanim im nizkar kodem shomea tefilla shoel et haggeshamim beshomea tefilla. veim achar shebberech shomea tefilla chozer levirkat hashshanim. veim lo nizkar ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh umitpallel sheniyya:

Taa velo hizkir yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyashlim tefillato chozer laavoda umazkir. veim nizkar achar shehishlim tefillato chozer larosh. veim haya ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato venizkar achar shehishlim tefillato kodem sheyyaakor raglav chozer laavoda:
Bamme devarim amurim bechullo shel moed o beshacharit uvemincha shel rashe chodashim. aval arvit shel rosh chodesh im lo hizkir eno chozer:

Kol makom shehayyachid chozer umitpallel shatz chozer umitpallel im taa kemoto beet shemmitpallel bekol ram. chutz mishshacharit shel rosh chodesh sheim shachach shatz velo hizkir yaale veyavo ad shehishlim tefillato en machzirin oto mippene torach tzibbur. shehare tefillat hammusafin lefanav shehu mazkir bah rosh chodesh:

Asara yamim shemmerosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim taa vechatam bahem bivracha shelishit hael hakkadosh chozer larosh. taa vechatam beashte esre melech ohev tzedaka umishpat chozer litchillat habberacha vechotem bah hammelech hammishpat umitpallel veholech al hasseder. veim lo nizkar ella ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur:

Taa velo hizkir havedala bechonen haddaat mashlim tefillato veeno tzarich lachazor. vechen mi shello hizkir al hannissim bachanukka uvefurim vaanenu bitfillat taanit eno chozer umitpallel. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur. veim nizkar kodem sheyyaakor et raglav omer anenu ki atta shomea tefilla pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer:

Shachach velo hitpallel mincha beerev shabbat yitpallel arvit shetayim shel shabbat. vechen beyom tov. shachach velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat o beyom tov mitpallel bemotzaehen arvit shetayim shel chol. mavdil barishona veeno mavdil bashsheniyya. veim hivdil bishtehen o lo hivdil beachat mehen yatza. aval im lo hivdil barishona vehivdil bashsheniyya chozer umitpallel tefilla shelishit mippene sheharishona lo alta lo mippene shehikdimah litfillat arvit. vechol hammitpallel shete tefillot afillu shacharit umusaf lo yitpallel zo achar zo ella yishhe ben tefilla litfilla kede shettitchonen dato alav:

Asur lo lammitpallel betzibbur sheyyakdim tefillato litfillat hatztzibbur. hannichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin belachash im yachol lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yitpallel. veim lav yamtin ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur lehitpallel bekol ram veyitpallel immo belachash milla bemilla ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha veone kedushsha im hatztzibbur umitpallel shear tefilla leatzmo. veim hitchil lehitpallel kodem sheliach tzibbur vehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha lo yafsik velo yaane kedushsha immahen. vechen lo yaane amen yehe shemeh rabba mevorach vehu beemtza hattefilla veen tzarich lomar bishar habberachot:
